## File: ./docs/components/tooltip-popover.md
```
# `tooltip-popover`

> Two siblings that share one file but almost nothing else. **Tooltip** = a single
> short, non-interactive string surfaced on hover/focus; a dark capsule that floats
> at a low elevation and vanishes on blur. **Popover** = a rich, interactive surface
> (text, buttons, a small form) surfaced on click; a light card at a higher
> elevation that traps focus until dismissed. They live together because both are
> *anchored, portalled overlays* — but they differ in trigger, interactivity,
> elevation, colour, and ARIA role. Pick by **interactivity**: if the user needs to
> *do* something inside it, it is a popover; if they only need to *read* it, it is a
> tooltip.

**Status:** `shipped`
**Since:** `v2.0`
**File:** `styles/components/tooltip-popover.css`
**Selector namespace:** `.dgo-tooltip` · `.dgo-popover` (BEM)

---

## 1 · Anatomy

The two surfaces are **parallel top-level classes**, not a nested pair — a tooltip
is never inside a popover and neither wraps the other. Each is a single element the
consumer's positioning layer mounts and places.

### `.dgo-tooltip`

- A single `inline-block` capsule. Owns: dark `--dgo-tooltip-bg` fill, white
  `--dgo-tooltip-fg` text, `--dgo-type-caption` size at `--dgo-wt-500` weight, a 6px
  (`--dgo-tooltip-radius`) radius, the `--dgo-shadow-3` drop shadow, and a
  `max-inline-size: 280px` wrap cap.
- **No child elements.** The tooltip contains one run of text and nothing else (see
  §13 — a tooltip with a button in it is an anti-pattern).

### `.dgo-popover`

- A single card surface. Owns: `--dgo-color-surface-raised` background, a 1px
  `--dgo-color-border-default` edge, a 10px (`--dgo-popover-radius`) radius,
  `--dgo-popover-pad` (12px) padding, the `--dgo-popover-shadow` elevation, and a
  `min-inline-size: 220px` floor.
- **Holds any DGO content** — headings, body text, buttons, a compact form. The
  popover is a container; its children are ordinary system components.

### No arrow / caret element

The shipped CSS draws **no** connector arrow on either surface. If a design calls
for a caret pointing at the trigger, it is the consumer's positioning library
(e.g. Floating UI's `arrow` middleware) that renders and places it — the system
ships the surface, not the pointer. Do not hand-roll a CSS-triangle arrow inside
`.dgo-tooltip` / `.dgo-popover`; it will not track the flip logic.

---

## 2 · Variants

No variants on either surface. A tooltip is always the dark capsule; a popover is
always the light card. Anchoring side, offset, and flip behaviour are the
consumer's positioning decision, not a class.

For a list-shaped popover (a menu of actions), use `.dgo-menu` portalled to the
trigger instead — it ships the `role="menu"` semantics and the roving-tabindex
contract a bare popover does not. For a search-shaped overlay, use the command
palette. The popover is for **bespoke** content that no other family covers.

---

## 3 · Sizes & density

Single size each. **Density has no effect on this family** — and this is worth
stating precisely because the box around it implies otherwise:

- `.dgo-tooltip` padding is the literal `6px 10px` (see §5 — a hardcoded value,
  not a token).
- `.dgo-popover` padding is `--dgo-popover-pad`, which resolves to the **fixed
  primitive** `--dgo-s-3` (12px). It does **not** read `--dgo-density-pad`, so it
  does not rebind under `[data-density="compact"]`.

Neither surface declares a density block and neither consumes a `--dgo-density-*`
token. An overlay is a transient, self-contained surface; it keeps one comfortable
internal rhythm regardless of the density of the page beneath it. (Earlier drafts
of this doc claimed density "adjusts internal padding via the `--dgo-density-pad`
chain" — that was boilerplate and is incorrect for this family; corrected
2026-06-05 against the shipped CSS.) See `docs/04-spacing-grid.md` §"Density".

---

## 4 · States

There is **no state styling in the CSS.** Both `.dgo-tooltip` and `.dgo-popover`
are painted always-visible; an "open" overlay is simply a *mounted* one (the same
"open = mounted" model as `.dgo-menu`). The `data-state` and `aria-expanded`
attributes below are written and read by the **consumer's JS**, not by the
stylesheet — they are the contract the JS must honour, documented here so the
visual and behavioural sides agree.

| Logical state | Attribute the consumer sets | Trigger | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tooltip shown | `data-state="open"` on the tooltip; trigger is the focused / hovered element | mouse hover **or** keyboard focus of the trigger | Non-interactive: the tooltip never receives focus itself. |
| Tooltip hidden | `data-state="closed"` / unmounted | blur or `Escape` | |
| Popover shown | `data-state="open"` on the popover; `aria-expanded="true"` on the trigger | click or `Enter`/`Space` on the trigger | Focus moves into the popover (see §8). |
| Popover hidden | `data-state="closed"` / unmounted; `aria-expanded="false"` | `Escape`, outside-click, or close button | Focus returns to the trigger. |

The CSS exposes **no** `[data-state]` selector to hook an enter/exit transition —
any open/close motion lives in the consumer's portal JS and must honour
`prefers-reduced-motion` there (see §10, §16).

---

## 5 · Tokens consumed

_Every entry below is a direct `var()` reference in
`styles/components/tooltip-popover.css`, verified against the shipped CSS on
2026-06-05. Tokens reached only through a component-token's internal chain (e.g.
`--dgo-shadow-4` behind `--dgo-popover-shadow`) are documented at their own tier,
not duplicated here._

### Tier 3 — Component tokens (`tokens.component.css`)

| Token | Resolves to | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `--dgo-tooltip-bg` | `--dgo-ink-900` (`#1B1A1A`) | Tooltip capsule fill — a near-black, **fixed across themes** (see note). |
| `--dgo-tooltip-fg` | `--dgo-ink-0` (`#FFFFFF`) | Tooltip text — white on ink-900, clears AAA. |
| `--dgo-tooltip-radius` | `--dgo-r-6` (6px) | Tooltip corner radius — one step tighter than the popover. |
| `--dgo-popover-radius` | `--dgo-radius-card` → `--dgo-r-10` (10px) | Popover corner radius (intent tier). |
| `--dgo-popover-pad` | `--dgo-s-3` (12px) | Popover interior padding (all sides). |
| `--dgo-popover-shadow` | `--dgo-elevation-popover` → `--dgo-shadow-4` | Popover drop shadow — the higher of the two elevations. |

### Tier 2 — Semantic tokens

| Token | Used for |
|---|---|
| `--dgo-color-surface-raised` | Popover background |
| `--dgo-color-border-default` | Popover 1px border |
| `--dgo-type-caption` | Tooltip font-size (12px) |

### Tier 1 — Primitives (read directly)

| Token | Resolved | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `--dgo-shadow-3` | `0 4px 6px …, 0 2px 4px …` (green-tinted) | **Tooltip** drop shadow — read as a primitive directly, one elevation *below* the popover (see §7). |
| `--dgo-wt-500` | medium | Tooltip font-weight |

### The two-elevation split

The tooltip's shadow is the **primitive** `--dgo-shadow-3`; the popover's is the
**component** token `--dgo-popover-shadow` → `--dgo-elevation-popover` →
`--dgo-shadow-4`. The popover therefore sits one elevation step *higher* than the
tooltip. That is intentional: a popover is an interactive surface the user is
acting inside, so it lifts further off the page; a tooltip is a light, transient
read-only hint that hovers just above its trigger. The tooltip reaching the
primitive directly (rather than an `--dgo-elevation-tooltip` intent token that does
not exist) is the one place this family steps past the intent tier — tracked in §16.

### Un-tokenised value in the CSS — known

`.dgo-tooltip` declares `padding: 6px 10px` as **literals**, contradicting the file
header's "every value is a var()" claim. The `6px`/`10px` pair is a deliberately
snug capsule fit (tighter than any `--dgo-s-*` step would give: `s-2` is 8px,
`s-1` is 4px), but it is a real exception to the system's token discipline and
does not rebind under theme or density. Tracked in §16. The popover, by contrast,
is fully tokenised.

---

## 6 · Layout & sizing

- **Tooltip inline-size:** intrinsic (`inline-block`), capped at
  `max-inline-size: 280px` — past that the string wraps onto a second line rather
  than running off-screen.
- **Popover inline-size:** intrinsic, with a `min-inline-size: 220px` floor so a
  popover never collapses narrower than a comfortable reading column even for one
  short sentence; it grows to fit its content up to the consumer's positioning
  bounds.
- **Block-size (both):** intrinsic — the sum of the content plus the surface's
  padding.
- **Internal spacing:** tooltip = the literal `6px 10px` (§5); popover =
  `--dgo-popover-pad` (12px, all sides). (Earlier drafts said "uses the
  component-tier padding tokens listed in §5" for both — true only of the popover;
  corrected 2026-06-05.)
- **Positioning:** none in the CSS. The consumer's positioning layer owns anchor,
  offset, side, and viewport-flip. See §8.
- **Container query:** none in v2.x.

---

## 7 · Composition

- **Contains:**
  - Tooltip — a single short text string. Nothing focusable, nothing interactive.
  - Popover — any DGO content: a heading, body copy, `.dgo-btn`s, a compact field
    or two. Treat it as a small card you own the inside of.
- **Contained by:** neither sits in normal flow — both are **portalled to
  `<body>`** by the consumer so they escape `overflow: hidden` ancestors and stack
  above the page on their elevation.
- **Conflicts with:**
  - **A tooltip on a popover trigger** — never. The same trigger cannot both
    describe-on-hover and disclose-on-click without the two overlays racing. If the
    trigger needs a label, give it an `aria-label` and reserve the overlay for the
    popover.
  - **An interactive element inside a tooltip** — never (see §13). Move it into a
    popover.
  - **A modal opened from inside a popover** — close the popover first; a popover
    dismisses on outside-click, which would race the modal's backdrop.

---

## 8 · Behaviour (JS contract)

Interactive. The shipped CSS styles surfaces that are **already mounted and
positioned**; the consumer's JS owns everything dynamic. The two surfaces have
**different** contracts:

### Tooltip (the lighter contract)

| Responsibility | Detail |
|---|---|
| Show / hide | On trigger `mouseenter` / `focus`; hide on `mouseleave` / `blur` / `Escape`. A short open delay (≈ 100–300ms) is conventional; closing is immediate. |
| Positioning | Anchor to the trigger, offset a few px, flip when it would overflow the viewport. |
| No focus management | The tooltip is non-interactive and **never** receives focus. It is referenced, not entered. |
| Wiring | Trigger carries `aria-describedby` pointing at the tooltip's `id` (see §10). |

### Popover (the heavier contract)

| Responsibility | Detail |
|---|---|
| Open / close | Toggle presence from the trigger's `click` / `Enter` / `Space` and from `Escape`, outside-click, and any in-popover close button. |
| Positioning | Same anchor-and-flip as the tooltip. |
| Focus management | On open, move focus into the popover (first focusable element, or the popover container if it has none). **Trap `Tab`** inside until close. On close, **return focus to the trigger**. |
| `aria-expanded` | Reflect open state on the trigger. |

### What the component (CSS) owns

Both surfaces' box, colour, radius, padding, elevation, and size floors/caps —
nothing dynamic. No `[data-state]` selector is styled; "open" is "mounted". See
`docs/08-accessibility.md` for the full overlay keyboard contract; the system
enforces visuals only.

---

## 9 · Keyboard

| Surface | Key | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Tooltip | (trigger) `Tab` | Focusing the trigger shows the tooltip via `:focus`. |
| Tooltip | `Escape` | Dismiss the tooltip while leaving trigger focus in place. |
| Tooltip | (trigger) blur | Dismiss. |
| Popover | (trigger) `Enter` / `Space` | Open the popover; move focus inside. |
| Popover | `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Cycle focus **within** the popover (trapped) until close. |
| Popover | `Escape` | Close and return focus to the trigger. |

The tooltip must appear on **keyboard `:focus-visible` of the trigger**, not on
hover alone — a hover-only tooltip is invisible to keyboard and touch users (§13).

---

## 10 · ARIA

| Surface | Role | Trigger wiring |
|---|---|---|
| Tooltip | `role="tooltip"` on the capsule | Trigger carries `aria-describedby="<tooltip-id>"`. The tooltip *describes* the trigger; it is not a label. |
| Popover | `role="dialog"` with `aria-labelledby` pointing at its own heading | Trigger carries `aria-expanded` and `aria-haspopup="dialog"`. |
| Popover (list-shaped) | If the popover is really a list of choices, use `role="listbox"` / `role="menu"` — but prefer the `.dgo-menu` family, which ships those semantics. | — |

A tooltip must reference a **focusable** trigger. A `<div>` with no `tabindex`
cannot surface its tooltip on keyboard focus (§13); use a real `<button>` or add
`tabindex="0"` to a genuinely interactive element.

### Forced-colours behaviour

Under `forced-colors: active` and `[data-theme="hc"]`:

- The popover swaps custom colour tokens for system colours — `--dgo-color-surface-raised`
  → `Canvas`, text → `CanvasText` — and the 1px border becomes a `CanvasText` edge.
  `--dgo-popover-shadow` drops; the border is then the only thing separating the
  popover from the page, which is why the 1px border is non-negotiable.
- The tooltip's `--dgo-tooltip-bg` / `-fg` map to `Canvas` / `CanvasText` (or the
  system tooltip colours where the engine provides them); `--dgo-shadow-3` drops and
  a forced 1px border carries the edge.

See `docs/07-elevation.md`.

### Reduced-motion behaviour

The CSS declares **no** transitions or animations on either surface, so there is
nothing in the stylesheet to collapse. Any enter/exit motion lives in the
consumer's portal JS and **must** be gated on
`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` there — the system cannot enforce motion
it does not own. See `docs/06-motion.md`.

---

## 11 · Internationalisation

- **Diacritic safety:** the tooltip is `--dgo-type-caption` (12px) at
  `--dgo-wt-500`; the 6px top padding plus the caption ramp's line-height keeps
  stacked Yorùbá / Hausa / Igbo combining marks (`ọ́`, `ǹ`) off the capsule's top
  edge. Popover body text uses the consumer's chosen type ramp; size it from the
  body ramp (`--dgo-lh-150`) so marks have vertical room.
- **RTL:** both surfaces use logical properties (`max-inline-size`,
  `min-inline-size`, logical padding), so width caps and floors follow the writing
  direction. The **anchoring side flips** under `[dir="rtl"]` — but that is the
  consumer's positioning layer's job; a popover anchored "to the end of the
  trigger" lands on the correct side automatically only if the positioning code is
  direction-aware.
- **Translation expansion:** tooltip strings wrap at the `280px` cap rather than
  clipping; popover content reflows. Never truncate either with
  `text-overflow: ellipsis` — a half-shown hint is worse than a wrapped one. Keep
  tooltip strings to one or two short lines; a tooltip that needs a paragraph is a
  popover.

---

## 12 · Examples

### Tooltip — basic

```html
<button id="trg" class="dgo-btn dgo-btn--icon" aria-describedby="tt1" aria-label="Routing help">
  <svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="../../assets/icons/sprite.svg#i-info"/></svg>
</button>

<!-- portalled to <body>, positioned by the consumer -->
<div class="dgo-tooltip" role="tooltip" id="tt1" data-state="open">
  Routing rules apply to dossiers approved after 14:00.
</div>
```

### Popover — interactive

```html
<button id="filters-trg"
        class="dgo-btn dgo-btn--secondary"
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-expanded="true"
        aria-controls="filters-pop">Filters</button>

<div class="dgo-popover" role="dialog" id="filters-pop" aria-labelledby="filters-h" data-state="open">
  <h3 id="filters-h" class="dgo-h4">Filter dossiers</h3>
  <label class="dgo-field">
    <span class="dgo-label">Desk</span>
    <span class="dgo-select">
      <select class="dgo-select__field">
        <option>Compliance</option>
        <option>Operations</option>
      </select>
    </span>
  </label>
  <footer class="dgo-modal__footer">
    <button class="dgo-btn dgo-btn--secondary" data-popover-close>Cancel</button>
    <button class="dgo-btn dgo-btn--primary">Apply</button>
  </footer>
</div>
```

### Inside a real composition

See the **Operator dashboard** and **Citizen portal** patterns at the bottom of the
showcase (`index.html`) — every shipped family appears in at least one of them.

---

## 13 · Anti-patterns

- ❌ A tooltip containing a button, link, or any focusable control.
  ✅ Tooltips are non-interactive read-only hints. If the user must *act*, use a
  popover — focus can enter a popover, never a tooltip.
- ❌ A popover that opens on **hover**.
  ✅ Popovers open on click / `Enter` so keyboard and touch users can reach the
  controls inside; a hover-opened interactive surface is unreachable for them.
- ❌ A tooltip on a non-focusable `<div>` (no `tabindex`).
  ✅ The trigger must be focusable — a real `<button>`, or `tabindex="0"` on a
  genuinely interactive element — or the tooltip never surfaces on keyboard focus.
- ❌ A hand-rolled CSS-triangle arrow inside `.dgo-tooltip` / `.dgo-popover`.
  ✅ Let the positioning library draw and place the caret so it tracks the flip
  logic — the system ships no arrow (§1).
- ❌ A tooltip carrying a paragraph of text.
  ✅ That is popover-shaped content. Tooltips are one or two short lines.
- ❌ Both a tooltip *and* a popover on the same trigger.
  ✅ One overlay per trigger; give the trigger an `aria-label` if it also needs a
  name.

Cross-link: `docs/12-anti-patterns.md`.

---

## 14 · Migration

v2.0 introduces this family. No migration from a v2 predecessor. For the v1 → v2
mapping (`dgo_digital_ops/` → `dgo-design-system/`), see `MIGRATION.md`.

| Version | From | To | Codemod |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.0 → 2.0 | `[v1 class — confirm]` | `.dgo-tooltip` / `.dgo-popover` | `[v1 maintainers: confirm regex]` |

---

## 15 · Browser & assistive-tech support

| Engine | Min version |
|---|---|
| Chromium-family | last 2 majors |
| Firefox | last 2 majors |
| WebKit (Safari) | last 2 majors |

| Feature | Required? | Fallback if absent |
|---|---|---|
| Logical properties (`max-inline-size`, `min-inline-size`, logical padding) | required | — |
| `forced-colors: active` styling | required | — |
| Portalling to `<body>` (consumer JS) | required | Overlay clips inside `overflow: hidden` ancestors. |
| CSS `anchor-name` positioning | **not yet** | Use a positioning library (Floating UI) until baseline (see §16). |

Assistive-tech tested:

- [ ] VoiceOver (macOS) + Safari
- [ ] VoiceOver (iOS) + Safari
- [ ] NVDA + Firefox
- [ ] NVDA + Chrome
- [ ] JAWS + Chrome
- [ ] TalkBack + Chrome (Android)

`[NITDA DS team: confirm AT test matrix funding]`. Until then this list is
aspirational. Highest-risk area to verify against real AT: the **popover**'s
`role="dialog"` + focus-trap + focus-return cycle, and whether `aria-describedby`
tooltips are announced consistently across NVDA/JAWS verbosity settings (tooltip
announcement is the most variable behaviour in this family).

---

## 16 · Open questions

- **The tooltip padding is the literal `6px 10px`**, not a token — a real exception
  to the system's "every value is a var()" discipline (§5). A
  `--dgo-tooltip-pad` component token (or a `4px 8px`-derived `--dgo-s-*` pairing)
  would close it; the current snug fit is intentional but un-tokenised. Track at
  `[NITDA DS team: file v2.x cleanup ticket]`.
- **The tooltip shadow reads the `--dgo-shadow-3` primitive directly** rather than
  an intent token — there is no `--dgo-elevation-tooltip` (the popover correctly
  uses `--dgo-elevation-popover`). Exposing a tooltip elevation intent token would
  bring the family fully Tier-2/3 and make the two-elevation split (§5) explicit in
  the token graph rather than implicit in the CSS.
- **No `[data-state]` styling hook.** "Open" is "mounted" today, so any CSS-driven
  enter/exit transition is impossible — motion must live in the consumer's portal
  JS. If a future consumer needs system-owned open/close motion (honouring
  `prefers-reduced-motion`), the family would need an explicit open-state attribute
  styled in the CSS.
- **CSS `anchor-name` positioning** is the long-term API for both surfaces; until
  baseline support is universal, consumers position with a library (Floating UI).
  When `anchor-name` baselines, a system-owned positioning layer could replace the
  per-consumer JS.

---

# `topbar`

> Horizontal app header. Persistent across the operator surface. Hosts the brand, page title, search, notifications, and the user menu.

**Status:** `shipped`
**Since:** `v2.0`
**File:** `styles/components/topbar.css`
**Selector namespace:** `.dgo-topbar` (BEM)

---

## 1 · Anatomy

DOM order, outermost to innermost:

- `.dgo-topbar` — flex row, sticky at the top of the viewport
- (slots) — consumer composition — inline-start: brand + breadcrumb; centre: search; inline-end: notifications + user menu

---

## 2 · Variants

No CSS variants. Density and content drive the visual.

---

## 3 · Sizes & density

Single size. **Density has no effect** — the topbar's height is `--dgo-topbar-h`,
which `tokens.density.css` does **not** rebind, and its `--dgo-s-4` / `--dgo-s-5`
gap and padding are fixed primitives. The app header keeps one constant height so
the page frame is stable while the content area below it switches density.
(Earlier drafts claimed "density adjusts internal padding via the
`--dgo-density-pad` chain" — boilerplate, incorrect for this family; corrected
2026-06-05 against the shipped CSS.) See `docs/04-spacing-grid.md` §"Density".

---

## 4 · States

- no states — topbar is a layout primitive

---

## 5 · Tokens consumed

_Every entry below is a direct `var()` reference in `styles/components/topbar.css`, verified against the shipped CSS on 2026-06-05. Tokens reached only through a component-token's internal chain are documented at their own tier, not duplicated here._

### Tier 3 — Component tokens (`tokens.component.css`)

- `--dgo-topbar-bg`
- `--dgo-topbar-border`
- `--dgo-topbar-h`

### Tier 2 — Semantic tokens

**None** — this family references no semantic-tier token directly.

### Tier 1 — Primitives

- `--dgo-s-4`
- `--dgo-s-5`
- `--dgo-z-sticky`

---

## 6 · Layout & sizing

- **Inline-size:** intrinsic — the bar spans its container (the page-shell column);
  consumer-bounded.
- **Block-size:** fixed at `--dgo-topbar-h` (a component token; does not rebind
  under density — §3).
- **Internal spacing:** `padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-5)`; `gap: var(--dgo-s-4)`
  between clusters — both fixed primitives, not component-tier tokens. (Earlier
  drafts said "uses the component-tier padding tokens listed in §5"; corrected
  2026-06-05.)
- **Sticky:** `position: sticky; inset-block-start: 0; z-index: var(--dgo-z-sticky)`
  — the bar pins to the top of the viewport above the scrolling content.
- **Container query:** none in v2.x.

---

## 7 · Composition

- **Contains:** `.dgo-crumbs`, `.dgo-search`, `.dgo-btn--icon`, `.dgo-avatar`
- **Contained by:** `<body>` / page shell, above `.dgo-sidebar`
- **Conflicts with:** Topbar inside a modal

---

## 8 · Behaviour (JS contract)

No JS — the component is declarative.

---

## 9 · Keyboard

Tab through the contained controls. The topbar itself is not focusable.

---

## 10 · ARIA

Wrap in `<header>`; use `<nav aria-label="Primary">` for the navigation cluster inside.

### Forced-colours behaviour

Under `forced-colors: active` the component swaps custom colour tokens for system colours (`Canvas`, `CanvasText`, `Highlight`, `HighlightText`). Elevation falls back to a 1px `CanvasText` border. See `docs/07-elevation.md`.

### Reduced-motion behaviour

Any transitions or animations on this family collapse to ≤ 50ms under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`. See `docs/06-motion.md`.

---

## 11 · Internationalisation

- **Diacritic safety:** body-size text uses `--dgo-lh-150` so Yorùbá, Hausa, and Igbo combining marks have room.
- **RTL:** logical properties throughout. Inline padding, gap, and icon placement flip under `[dir="rtl"]`.
- **Translation expansion:** long labels wrap inline; never truncate with `text-overflow: ellipsis` without a tooltip for the full string.

---

<header class="dgo-topbar">

    <span class="dgo-avatar">AO</span>
  </div>
</header>
```

  ✅ Sticky is the default.

  }
  .doc-hero h1 { color: #fff; max-width: 18ch; font-size: clamp(40px, 5vw, 60px); }
  .doc-hero p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); max-width: 60ch; margin-top: var(--dgo-s-4); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-lg); }
  .doc-hero__orbit {
    position: absolute; right: -80px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 380px; height: 380px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid rgba(23,178,85,0.4);
  }
  .doc-hero__orbit::before, .doc-hero__orbit::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 60px; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(23,178,85,0.25);
  }
  .doc-hero__orbit::after { inset: 130px; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
  .doc-hero__dot {
    position: absolute; inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    width: 14px; height: 14px; margin: -7px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: #17B255;
  }
  .doc-hero__meta {
    display: flex; gap: var(--dgo-s-6); margin-top: var(--dgo-s-8);
    font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
  }
  .doc-hero__meta b { color: #fff; font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); display: block; font-size: var(--dgo-type-h4); font-family: var(--dgo-family-display); }

  .doc-section { margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-12); scroll-margin-top: var(--dgo-s-6); }
  .doc-section > h2 {
    font-size: var(--dgo-type-h2);
    margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-2);
  }
  .doc-section > h2 + p { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); max-width: 70ch; margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-6); }
  .doc-section > h3 {
    font-size: var(--dgo-type-h4);
    margin-block-start: var(--dgo-s-7); margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-4);
    padding-block-end: var(--dgo-s-2); border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  }

  .doc-panel {
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
    padding: var(--dgo-s-6);
    margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-4);
  }

  .swatch-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: var(--dgo-s-3); }
  .swatch {
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-control);
    overflow: clip;
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
  }
  .swatch__chip { height: 72px; }
  .swatch__meta { padding: var(--dgo-s-2) var(--dgo-s-3); font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption); }
  .swatch__meta b { display: block; font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); }
  .swatch__meta span { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); }

  .contrast-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: var(--dgo-s-3); }
  .contrast {
    border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-control);
    padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
    font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  }
  .contrast b { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-lg); }
  .contrast small { font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); }
  .contrast .ratio { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); }

  .type-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--dgo-s-6); padding: var(--dgo-s-3) 0; border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default); }
  .type-row:last-child { border: 0; }
  .type-row__meta { width: 130px; flex-shrink: 0; font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); }

  .space-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-4); padding: var(--dgo-s-2) 0; }
  .space-row__bar { height: 12px; background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); border-radius: 2px; }
  .space-row__meta { font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); width: 80px; }

  .demo-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: var(--dgo-s-3); }
  .demo {
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
    overflow: clip;
  }
  .demo__stage { padding: var(--dgo-s-6); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--dgo-s-3); align-items: center; min-height: 100px; }
  .demo__label { padding: var(--dgo-s-2) var(--dgo-s-4); border-block-start: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default); background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken); font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-wide); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600); }

  .theme-toggle {
    position: fixed; bottom: var(--dgo-s-6); right: var(--dgo-s-6);
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
    padding: 4px;
    display: flex; gap: 2px;
    box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-3);
    z-index: var(--dgo-z-fixed);
  }
  .theme-toggle button {
    padding: 6px 12px; font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  }
  .theme-toggle button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand); }

  .icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .icon-sm { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

  /* Logo cards */
  .logo-card { background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page); border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default); border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card); padding: var(--dgo-s-6); display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 180px; }
  .logo-card--green { background: var(--dgo-color-surface-brand); }
  .logo-card--ink { background: var(--dgo-ink-900); }
  .logo-card img { max-width: 80%; max-height: 100px; }

  /* Token usage example "code" block */
  .doc-code {
    font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono);
    font-size: 12px;
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-inverse);
    color: #C5E5D2;
    padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
    overflow-x: auto;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .doc-code .kw { color: #F6CE5C; }
  .doc-code .str { color: #82BFE8; }
  .doc-code .cm { color: #6F7E78; }

  .endorsement-strip {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
    padding: var(--dgo-s-2) var(--dgo-s-4);
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-widest); text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
    width: max-content;
  }
  .endorsement-strip::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent); }

  /* Per-component doc cross-link strip */
  .doc-xref {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 4px 10px 4px 8px;
    margin: -4px 0 var(--dgo-s-5);
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
    font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
    color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: border-color var(--dgo-motion-state), background var(--dgo-motion-state);
  }
  .doc-xref:hover { border-color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); background: var(--dgo-green-50); }
  .doc-xref::before {
    content: "";
    width: 16px; height: 16px;
    background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent);
    -webkit-mask: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z'/><polyline points='14 2 14 8 20 8'/><line x1='9' y1='13' x2='15' y2='13'/><line x1='9' y1='17' x2='15' y2='17'/></svg>") center/contain no-repeat;
            mask: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z'/><polyline points='14 2 14 8 20 8'/><line x1='9' y1='13' x2='15' y2='13'/><line x1='9' y1='17' x2='15' y2='17'/></svg>") center/contain no-repeat;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .doc-xref code { font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); }

  /* Documentation inventory grid */
  .docs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: var(--dgo-s-3); }
  .docs-card {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
    padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
    transition: border-color var(--dgo-motion-state), box-shadow var(--dgo-motion-state), transform var(--dgo-dur-instant) var(--dgo-ease-sharp);
  }
  .docs-card:hover { border-color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .docs-card__num {
    font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--dgo-color-fg-subtle); letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .docs-card__title { font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body); }
  .docs-card__desc { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); line-height: 1.5; }
  .docs-card__tag {
    margin-top: 4px; align-self: flex-start;
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700);
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
    background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary-soft);
    color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  }
  .docs-card__tag--proposed { background: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg); }
  .docs-card__tag--evergreen { background: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-fg); }

  /* Documentation roadmap meter */
  .docs-meter {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr));
    gap: var(--dgo-s-3); margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-6);
  }
  .docs-meter__cell {
    padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
    border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
  }
  .docs-meter__value {
    font-family: var(--dgo-family-display);
    font-size: var(--dgo-type-h2);
    font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700);
    color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .docs-meter__value small { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-400); font-family: var(--dgo-family-sans); margin-inline-start: 4px; }
  .docs-meter__label {
    margin-top: 6px;
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-subtle);
  }
  .docs-meter__bar {
    margin-top: 10px; height: 6px;
    background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken);
    border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill); overflow: hidden;
  }
  .docs-meter__fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--dgo-color-action-primary), var(--dgo-color-action-accent));
    border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
  }
</style>
</head>

  <main id="main" class="doc-main">

    <!-- HERO -->
    <header class="doc-hero">
      <div class="doc-hero__orbit"><div class="doc-hero__dot"></div></div>
      <div class="endorsement-strip" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); margin-bottom: var(--dgo-s-5);">
        <span>An Initiative of NITDA</span>
      </div>
      <h1>The operational nervous system for Nigeria's digital services.</h1>
      <p>DGO Design System v2.1 — an enterprise-grade, NITDA-endorsed token, component, and pattern library for government operators, agency admins, and citizens. Light, dark &amp; high-contrast themes. Comfortable &amp; compact densities. WCAG 2.2 AA across the matrix.</p>

      <div class="doc-hero__meta">
        <div><b>347+</b><span>Design tokens</span></div>
        <div><b>27</b><span>Component families</span></div>
        <div><b>3</b><span>Themes</span></div>
        <div><b>2</b><span>Densities</span></div>
        <div><b>4</b><span>Languages</span></div>
      </div>
    </header>


    <!-- ============= BRAND ============= -->
    <section id="brand" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Brand &amp; NITDA Endorsement</h2>
      <p>DGO is the operational sub-brand of NITDA — parent · child, never co-equal. Three reinforcement layers (geometry, color, lockup) ensure the relationship reads at every scale.</p>

      <div class="dgo-grid dgo-grid--3" style="gap: var(--dgo-s-4);">
        <div class="logo-card"><img src="assets/logo/horizontal.svg" alt="DGO horizontal"></div>
        <div class="logo-card"><img src="assets/logo/stacked.svg" alt="DGO stacked"></div>
        <div class="logo-card"><img src="assets/logo/mark.svg" alt="DGO mark only" style="max-width: 80px;"></div>
        <div class="logo-card logo-card--green"><img src="assets/logo/white-out.svg" alt="DGO white-out"></div>
        <div class="logo-card"><img src="assets/logo/nitda-endorsed.svg" alt="DGO endorsed by NITDA"></div>
        <div class="logo-card logo-card--ink">
          <div style="color: #fff; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;">
            <div style="opacity: 0.6; margin-bottom: 4px;">Construction</div>
            <svg width="120" height="80" viewBox="0 0 120 80">
              <g stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 3">
                <line x1="0" y1="20" x2="120" y2="20"/>
                <line x1="0" y1="40" x2="120" y2="40"/>
                <line x1="0" y1="60" x2="120" y2="60"/>
                <line x1="30" y1="0" x2="30" y2="80"/>
                <line x1="60" y1="0" x2="60" y2="80"/>
                <line x1="90" y1="0" x2="90" y2="80"/>
              </g>
              <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#17B255" stroke-width="2.5"/>
              <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="5" fill="#fff"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h3>Endorsement lockup</h3>
      <div class="doc-panel" style="display: flex; gap: var(--dgo-s-6); align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <p style="margin:0; max-width: 50ch; color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);">Every official surface must carry the <code class="dgo-inline-code">AN INITIATIVE OF NITDA</code> lockup. Clear space = 1× height of "D" in DGO.</p>
        <div class="endorsement-strip"><span>An Initiative of NITDA</span></div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ============= COLOR ============= -->
    <section id="color" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Color</h2>
      <p>Primary Deep Green is a sibling shade of NITDA's institutional green. Smart Green signals "operational/active" — reserved for accents, focus, success, and the orbit ring. Ink is warm-cool neutral. Status colors have subtle and strong pairings.</p>

      <h3>Primary — Deep Green (NITDA-sibling)</h3>
      <div class="swatch-grid">
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-50)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-50</b><span>#EAF3EF</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-100)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-100</b><span>#CFE3D8</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-200)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-200</b><span>#A4CCB7</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-400)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-400</b><span>#3D8E69</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-600)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-600</b><span>#0C603F</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-700); position: relative;"><span style="position: absolute; inset: auto auto 6px 8px; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-weight: 600;">BASE</span></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-700</b><span>#05583B</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-800)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-800</b><span>#033F2A</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-green-900)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>green-900</b><span>#022819</span></div></div>
      </div>

      <h3>Accent — Smart Green (operational)</h3>
      <div class="swatch-grid">
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-smart-50)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>smart-50</b><span>#E6F7ED</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-smart-200)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>smart-200</b><span>#8BD9A9</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-smart-400); position: relative;"><span style="position: absolute; inset: auto auto 6px 8px; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-weight: 600;">BASE</span></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>smart-400</b><span>#17B255</span></div></div>
        <div class="swatch"><div class="swatch__chip" style="background: var(--dgo-smart-500)"></div><div class="swatch__meta"><b>smart-500</b><span>#119143</span></div></div>

    <!-- ============= CONTRAST MATRIX ============= -->
    <section id="contrast" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Contrast matrix</h2>
      <p>Every semantic color pairing exceeds WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 text / 3:1 UI). The high-contrast theme pushes pairs to AAA where possible.</p>
      <div class="contrast-grid">
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #fff; color: #1B1A1A; border-color: var(--dgo-ink-100);"><b>Body on paper</b><small>#1B1A1A on #FFFFFF</small><span class="ratio">16.7 : 1 · AAA</span></div>
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #fff; color: #05583B;"><b>Brand link</b><small>#05583B on #FFFFFF</small><span class="ratio">10.6 : 1 · AAA</span></div>
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #05583B; color: #fff;"><b>On brand surface</b><small>#FFFFFF on #05583B</small><span class="ratio">10.6 : 1 · AAA</span></div>
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #17B255; color: #fff;"><b>On smart green</b><small>#FFFFFF on #17B255</small><span class="ratio">3.06 : 1 · UI / large</span></div>
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #FBF1D8; color: #5A3F00;"><b>Warning subtle</b><small>#5A3F00 on #FBF1D8</small><span class="ratio">9.4 : 1 · AAA</span></div>
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #FBE7EB; color: #780820;"><b>Danger subtle</b><small>#780820 on #FBE7EB</small><span class="ratio">10.5 : 1 · AAA</span></div>
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #E6F0F8; color: #054871;"><b>Info subtle</b><small>#054871 on #E6F0F8</small><span class="ratio">9.7 : 1 · AAA</span></div>
        <div class="contrast" style="background: #E6F7ED; color: #119143;"><b>Success subtle</b><small>#119143 on #E6F7ED</small><span class="ratio">4.6 : 1 · AA</span></div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ============= TYPOGRAPHY ============= -->
    <section id="typography" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Typography</h2>
      <p>Outfit for display, Inter for UI, Verdana for long-form body, JetBrains Mono for code. 1.200 modular scale, 8 steps. Body line-height 1.5 — safe for Yoruba, Hausa, and Igbo diacritics.</p>

      <div class="doc-panel">
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">display-xxl<br>60 / 800 / -2%</div><div class="dgo-display-xxl">Federal Service.</div></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">display<br>40 / 700 / -1%</div><div class="dgo-display">Operating Nigeria's digital public services</div></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">h1<br>33 / 700 / -1%</div><h1>Approve, route, reply.</h1></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">h2<br>28 / 700</div><h2>Yorùbá: Àpèjúwe ìtàkùn</h2></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">h3<br>23 / 600</div><h3>Igbo: Ọrụ ndị ọzọ</h3></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">h4<br>19 / 600</div><h4>Hausa: Tsarin gwamnati</h4></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">body-lg<br>16 / 400 / 1.5</div><p class="dgo-body-lg" style="max-width: 60ch;">The Agency administers IT project clearance, .gov.ng domain registration, and OEM certification across the federation. Standard reading line at 16px.</p></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">body<br>14 / 400 / 1.5</div><p style="max-width: 60ch;">Default UI text — table cells, form helpers, paragraph body. Tight enough for dense operator screens but comfortable for sustained reading.</p></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">caption<br>12 / 400 / 1.4</div><p class="dgo-caption">Last updated 2 minutes ago · Task #00423 · routed by Adamu Bello</p></div>
        <div class="type-row"><div class="type-row__meta">overline<br>12 / 600 / 0.14em</div><p class="dgo-overline">An Initiative of NITDA</p></div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ============= SPACING ============= -->

      <p>4pt base grid, 0–24. Density tokens (<code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-density-pad</code>, <code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-density-gap</code>) switch via <code class="dgo-inline-code">data-density</code>.</p>

    <!-- ============= RADIUS ============= -->
    <section id="radius" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Radius</h2>
      <p>Conservative scale 0–24px + pill. <code class="dgo-inline-code">radius-card</code> (10px) and <code class="dgo-inline-code">radius-frame</code> (18px) are the workhorses.</p>
      <div class="doc-panel" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: var(--dgo-s-3);">
        <div style="text-align: center;"><div style="width: 80px; height: 80px; background: var(--dgo-green-100); border-radius: var(--dgo-r-2); margin: 0 auto 8px;"></div><small>r-2 · 2px</small></div>
        <div style="text-align: center;"><div style="width: 80px; height: 80px; background: var(--dgo-green-100); border-radius: var(--dgo-r-4); margin: 0 auto 8px;"></div><small>r-4 · 4px</small></div>
        <div style="text-align: center;"><div style="width: 80px; height: 80px; background: var(--dgo-green-100); border-radius: var(--dgo-r-6); margin: 0 auto 8px;"></div><small>r-6 · 6px (control)</small></div>
        <div style="text-align: center;"><div style="width: 80px; height: 80px; background: var(--dgo-green-100); border-radius: var(--dgo-r-10); margin: 0 auto 8px;"></div><small>r-10 · 10px (card)</small></div>
        <div style="text-align: center;"><div style="width: 80px; height: 80px; background: var(--dgo-green-100); border-radius: var(--dgo-r-18); margin: 0 auto 8px;"></div><small>r-18 · 18px (frame)</small></div>
        <div style="text-align: center;"><div style="width: 80px; height: 80px; background: var(--dgo-green-100); border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill); margin: 0 auto 8px;"></div><small>pill · 9999px</small></div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ============= ELEVATION ============= -->
    <section id="elevation" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Elevation</h2>
      <p>Green-tinted shadows so depth reads as part of the brand, not generic Material drop-shadow.</p>
      <div class="doc-panel" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: var(--dgo-s-5); padding: var(--dgo-s-8);">
        <div style="background: #fff; height: 90px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-1); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px;">shadow-1</div>
        <div style="background: #fff; height: 90px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-2); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px;">shadow-2</div>
        <div style="background: #fff; height: 90px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-3); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px;">shadow-3</div>
        <div style="background: #fff; height: 90px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-4); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px;">shadow-4</div>
        <div style="background: #fff; height: 90px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-5); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px;">shadow-5</div>
        <div style="background: #fff; height: 90px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-6); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono); font-size: 11px;">shadow-6</div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ============= MOTION ============= -->
    <section id="motion" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Motion</h2>
      <p>Five durations × five easings × choreography rules. Reduced-motion media query collapses everything ≤ 50ms.</p>
      <div class="doc-panel">
        <table class="dgo-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Token</th><th>Value</th><th>Use</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-dur-instant</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">50ms</td><td>Press / micro-feedback</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-dur-fast</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">150ms</td><td>Hover, exit transitions</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-dur-base</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">250ms</td><td>State changes (default)</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-dur-slow</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">400ms</td><td>Entrances (modal, toast)</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-dur-deliberate</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">600ms</td><td>Hero, large traversals</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-ease-standard</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)</td><td>Default</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-ease-entrance</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1)</td><td>Decel — element appears</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-ease-exit</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1)</td><td>Accel — element leaves</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-ease-emphasized</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1.2)</td><td>Hero, attention</td></tr>
            <tr><td><code class="dgo-inline-code">--dgo-ease-sharp</code></td><td class="dgo-table__num">cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1)</td><td>Quick state flips</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="citizen" class="doc-section">

    <!-- ============= ACCESSIBILITY ============= -->
    <section id="a11y" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Accessibility — WCAG 2.2 AA</h2>
      <div class="dgo-grid dgo-grid--2">
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Focus</h3>
          <p style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);">3px Smart Green ring, 2px offset, never <code class="dgo-inline-code">outline:none</code> without replacement.</p>
          <div style="margin-top: 12px; display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
            <button class="dgo-btn dgo-btn--primary" style="box-shadow: var(--dgo-focus-ring);">Focused button</button>
            <input class="dgo-input" style="box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-action-primary) 22%, transparent); border-color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); width: 200px;" value="Focused input">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Targets</h3>
          <p style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);">≥ 24×24 CSS px desktop · ≥ 44×44 touch. Tabs sit at 40px, primary buttons at 40px, sm at 32px (with adequate spacing).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Semantics</h3>
          <p style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);">Buttons are <code class="dgo-inline-code">&lt;button&gt;</code>. Tabs use <code class="dgo-inline-code">role="tab"</code> + <code class="dgo-inline-code">aria-selected</code>. Form errors use <code class="dgo-inline-code">aria-invalid</code> + <code class="dgo-inline-code">aria-describedby</code>. Toasts use <code class="dgo-inline-code">role="status"</code>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Reduced motion</h3>
          <p style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);"><code class="dgo-inline-code">prefers-reduced-motion: reduce</code> collapses every motion token to ≤ 50ms. No transform animations on critical paths.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ============= COMMAND PALETTE (v2.1) ============= -->
    <section id="cmdk" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Command Palette <span class="dgo-badge dgo-badge--neutral" style="vertical-align: middle; font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);">v2.1 · interactive</span></h2>
      <p>The first <em>worked example</em> against §11. WAI-ARIA APG 1.2 combobox with <code class="dgo-inline-code">aria-activedescendant</code>; the input keeps focus while the active row moves. <strong>Try it:</strong> <code class="dgo-inline-code">Ctrl</code> + <code class="dgo-inline-code">K</code> (or <code class="dgo-inline-code">⌘</code> + <code class="dgo-inline-code">K</code>) anywhere on this page.</p>
      <a class="doc-xref" href="docs/components/command-palette.md">Full component contract <code>docs/components/command-palette.md</code></a>

      <div class="dgo-grid dgo-grid--3" style="margin-block: var(--dgo-s-5) var(--dgo-s-4);">
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Keyboard map</h3>
          <ul style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); padding-inline-start: 1.2em; margin: 0; line-height: 1.7;">
            <li><kbd class="dgo-kbd">Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd class="dgo-kbd">K</kbd> — open</li>
            <li><kbd class="dgo-kbd">↑</kbd> <kbd class="dgo-kbd">↓</kbd> — navigate</li>
            <li><kbd class="dgo-kbd">↵</kbd> — invoke</li>
            <li><kbd class="dgo-kbd">Esc</kbd> — clear, then close</li>
            <li><kbd class="dgo-kbd">Tab</kbd> — close (deliberate)</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Why activedescendant</h3>
          <p style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);">Real focus stays on the <code class="dgo-inline-code">&lt;input&gt;</code> the entire time. Moving real focus into the listbox would break continued typing. The "active" row is communicated via <code class="dgo-inline-code">aria-selected="true"</code> and the input's <code class="dgo-inline-code">aria-activedescendant</code> pointer.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Tab closes</h3>
          <p style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);">A divergence from typical dialog focus-traps. A command palette is <em>transient</em>; keyboard users expect Tab to leave the way it leaves a menu. The footer is therefore decorative — by design. See doc §9.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="demo" style="position: relative; min-block-size: 380px; padding: 0; background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default); border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-frame); overflow: hidden;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: var(--dgo-s-3) var(--dgo-s-4); border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default); background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);">
          <div style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-3);">
            <span class="dgo-overline" style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-subtle);">Demo stage</span>
            <span style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);">Press <kbd class="dgo-kbd">Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd class="dgo-kbd">K</kbd>, or</span>
          </div>
          <button class="dgo-btn dgo-btn--secondary dgo-btn--sm" id="cmdkOpen">
            <svg class="icon-sm" aria-hidden="true"><use href="assets/icons/sprite.svg#i-search"/></svg>
            Open palette
          </button>
        </div>
        <div style="padding: var(--dgo-s-6); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); display: grid; place-items: center; min-block-size: 320px; text-align: center;">
          <div>
            <p style="font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-lg); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-strong); margin: 0 0 var(--dgo-s-2);">Stage focus is anywhere on this page.</p>
            <p style="font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); margin: 0;">The palette mounts to <code class="dgo-inline-code">&lt;body&gt;</code> and traps the <kbd class="dgo-kbd">Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd class="dgo-kbd">K</kbd> chord at capture phase.<br>It honours your current theme &amp; density picks below.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

Bracketed <code class="dgo-inline-code">[NITDA legal: …]</code> / <code class="dgo-inline-code">[NITDA DS team: …]</code> markers indicate fields the agency must confirm before a public release.</p>
      <div class="docs-grid">

    </section>


    <!-- ============= GOVERNANCE ============= -->
    <section id="govern" class="doc-section">
      <h2>Governance</h2>
      <p style="margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-5);">Project-root scaffolding for adoption, contribution, and release. The bracketed <code class="dgo-inline-code">[NITDA legal: …]</code> / <code class="dgo-inline-code">[NITDA DS team: …]</code> markers flag every field the agency must confirm before a public drop — the structure (sections, ordering, trademark separation, brand carve-out, RFC clock, deprecation cadence) is design-system work and is ready as-is.</p>

      <div class="dgo-grid dgo-grid--2">
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Token naming</h3>
          <p class="dgo-caption" style="margin-bottom: 8px;">primitive → semantic → component</p>
          <pre class="doc-code"><span class="cm">// primitive (raw)</span>
<span class="kw">--dgo-green-700</span>: <span class="str">#05583B</span>;

<span class="cm">// semantic (intent)</span>
<span class="kw">--dgo-color-action-primary</span>: <span class="str">var(--dgo-green-700)</span>;

<span class="cm">// component (binding)</span>
<span class="kw">--dgo-btn-bg-primary</span>: <span class="str">var(--dgo-color-action-primary)</span>;</pre>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Semver &amp; deprecation</h3>
          <ul style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); padding-inline-start: 1.2em;">
            <li>MAJOR — breaking removals (1 minor warning required)</li>
            <li>MINOR — additive tokens, components, themes</li>
            <li>PATCH — visual fix, no API change</li>
            <li><code class="dgo-inline-code">@deprecated</code> CSS comment + console warn on use</li>
            <li>RFCs for any new component family</li>
            <li>Six-month notice on token / class / attribute renames</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Decision paths</h3>
          <ol style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); padding-inline-start: 1.2em;">
            <li><strong>PATCH</strong> — direct PR, one review.</li>
            <li><strong>MINOR additive</strong> — issue → PR, two reviews + family owner.</li>
            <li><strong>MAJOR breaking</strong> — RFC required; deprecation ships in the prior minor.</li>
            <li><strong>RFC</strong> — new component family, theme, density, or template change. Two-week clock + steward sign-off.</li>
          </ol>
          <p style="margin-block-start: var(--dgo-s-3);"><a class="doc-xref" href="GOVERNANCE.md">Full policy <code>GOVERNANCE.md</code></a></p>
        </div>
        <div class="dgo-card">
          <h3 class="dgo-card__title">Release gates</h3>
          <ul style="color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); padding-inline-start: 1.2em;">
            <li>Changelog block renamed and dated</li>
            <li>README counts table reflects the release</li>
            <li>Showcase carries one demo per new family</li>
            <li>Every new family has a full §11 fill on disk</li>
            <li>Smoke-pass under light · dark · HC × comfortable · compact</li>
            <li>A11y reviewer sign-off; brand-custodian sign-off if assets touched</li>
          </ul>
          <p style="margin-block-start: var(--dgo-s-3);"><a class="doc-xref" href="CONTRIBUTING.md">PR shape &amp; checklist <code>CONTRIBUTING.md</code></a></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


  </main>
</div>

<div class="dgo-cmdk-backdrop" id="cmdkBackdrop" data-state="closed">
  <div class="dgo-cmdk" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="cmdk-title" id="cmdkDialog">
    <h2 id="cmdk-title" class="dgo-visually-hidden">Command Palette</h2>

    <div class="dgo-cmdk__search">
      <svg class="dgo-cmdk__search-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="assets/icons/sprite.svg#i-search"/></svg>
      <input
        class="dgo-cmdk__input"
        id="cmdkInput"
        type="text"
        role="combobox"
        aria-expanded="true"
        aria-controls="cmdkListbox"
        aria-activedescendant=""
        aria-autocomplete="list"
        aria-label="Search commands, dossiers, and operators"
        placeholder="Search commands, dossiers, operators…"
        autocomplete="off"
        spellcheck="false"
      >
      <span class="dgo-cmdk__hint" aria-hidden="true">↑↓ ↵ Esc</span>

    <ul class="dgo-cmdk__listbox" id="cmdkListbox" role="listbox" aria-label="Results"></ul>

    <div class="dgo-cmdk__footer">
      <span class="dgo-cmdk__footer-hint">
        <kbd class="dgo-kbd">↑↓</kbd> navigate ·
        <kbd class="dgo-kbd">↵</kbd> select ·
        <kbd class="dgo-kbd">Esc</kbd> dismiss ·
        <kbd class="dgo-kbd">Tab</kbd> close
      </span>
      <span class="dgo-cmdk__footer-brand">DGO · cmdk</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- a11y live region for result-count announcements -->
<span class="dgo-visually-hidden" role="status" aria-live="polite" id="cmdkStatus"></span>

<script>
  /* ============================================================
     Command Palette behaviour — illustrative, system-shipped CSS only.
     Implements docs/components/command-palette.md §8 (JS contract).
     ============================================================ */
  (function () {
    const COMMANDS = [
      { group: 'Navigation', icon: 'i-home',     label: 'Dashboard',                 meta: ['G','D'] },
      { group: 'Navigation', icon: 'i-folder',   label: 'Dossiers',                  meta: ['G','O'] },
      { group: 'Navigation', icon: 'i-users',    label: 'Operators directory',       meta: ['G','U'] },
      { group: 'Navigation', icon: 'i-chart',    label: 'Reports & analytics',       meta: ['G','R'] },
      { group: 'Navigation', icon: 'i-settings', label: 'Settings',                  meta: ['G','S'] },

      { group: 'Actions',    icon: 'i-plus',     label: 'New dossier',                meta: ['Ctrl','N'] },
      { group: 'Actions',    icon: 'i-mail',     label: 'Compose routed message',     meta: ['Ctrl','M'] },
      { group: 'Actions',    icon: 'i-check',    label: 'Approve selected task',      meta: ['Ctrl','↵'] },
      { group: 'Actions',    icon: 'i-download', label: 'Export CSV (filtered view)', meta: ['Ctrl','⇧','E'] },
      { group: 'Actions',    icon: 'i-archive',  label: 'Restore from archive',       meta: null, disabled: true, badge: 'Compliance only' },

      { group: 'Recent dossiers', icon: 'i-file', label: 'DGO/2026/0421 — Domain transfer · nimc.gov.ng', meta: 'opened 2m' },
      { group: 'Recent dossiers', icon: 'i-file', label: 'DGO/2026/0418 — IT clearance · NPC HQ',         meta: 'opened 14m' },
      { group: 'Recent dossiers', icon: 'i-file', label: 'DGO/2026/0411 — OEM cert · Zinox Tech',         meta: 'opened 1h' },
      { group: 'Recent dossiers', icon: 'i-file', label: 'DGO/2026/0397 — License audit · Galaxy Backbone', meta: 'opened yesterday' },

      { group: 'Help',       icon: 'i-info',     label: 'Keyboard shortcuts',         meta: '?' },
      { group: 'Help',       icon: 'i-globe',    label: 'Switch language (Yorùbá · Hausa · Igbo)', meta: null },
    ];

    const $backdrop = document.getElementById('cmdkBackdrop');
    const $dialog   = document.getElementById('cmdkDialog');
    const $input    = document.getElementById('cmdkInput');
    const $listbox  = document.getElementById('cmdkListbox');
    const $status   = document.getElementById('cmdkStatus');
    const $main     = document.getElementById('content') || document.querySelector('main');

    let activeIndex = 0;
    let visible = [];
    let lastTrigger = null;

    function escapeHTML(s) {
      return s.replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
    }

    function highlight(label, q) {
      if (!q) return escapeHTML(label);
      const i = label.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase());
      if (i < 0) return escapeHTML(label);
      return escapeHTML(label.slice(0, i))
        + '<mark>' + escapeHTML(label.slice(i, i + q.length)) + '</mark>'
        + escapeHTML(label.slice(i + q.length));
    }

    function metaHTML(m) {
      if (m == null) return '';
      if (Array.isArray(m)) return m.map(k => `<kbd class="dgo-kbd">${escapeHTML(k)}</kbd>`).join('');
      return `<span>${escapeHTML(m)}</span>`;
    }

    function render(q) {
      q = (q || '').trim();
      const filtered = q
        ? COMMANDS.filter(c => c.label.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))
        : COMMANDS.slice();

      visible = filtered;
      $listbox.innerHTML = '';

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'dgo-cmdk__empty';
        li.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        li.innerHTML = `<strong>No matches</strong>Try a different keyword, or press <kbd class="dgo-kbd">Esc</kbd> to dismiss.`;
        $listbox.appendChild(li);
        $listbox.setAttribute('data-empty', 'true');
        $input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', '');
        $status.textContent = 'No results';
        return;
      }

      $listbox.setAttribute('data-empty', 'false');

      // Group consecutively
      let lastGroup = null;
      let groupUL = null;
      filtered.forEach((cmd, i) => {
        if (cmd.group !== lastGroup) {
          const groupLi = document.createElement('li');
          groupLi.className = 'dgo-cmdk__group';
          groupLi.setAttribute('role', 'group');
          const gid = 'cmdk-g-' + i;
          groupLi.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', gid);
          const label = document.createElement('div');
          label.className = 'dgo-cmdk__group-label';
          label.id = gid;
          label.textContent = cmd.group;
          groupUL = document.createElement('ul');
          groupLi.appendChild(label);
          groupLi.appendChild(groupUL);
          $listbox.appendChild(groupLi);
          lastGroup = cmd.group;
        }

        const item = document.createElement('li');
        item.className = 'dgo-cmdk__item';
        item.id = 'cmdk-i-' + i;
        item.setAttribute('role', 'option');
        item.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === activeIndex ? 'true' : 'false');
        if (cmd.disabled) item.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
        item.dataset.index = String(i);

        item.innerHTML = `
          <svg class="dgo-cmdk__item-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="assets/icons/sprite.svg#${cmd.icon}"/></svg>
          <span class="dgo-cmdk__item-label">${highlight(cmd.label, q)}</span>
          <span class="dgo-cmdk__item-meta">${cmd.badge ? `<span class="dgo-badge dgo-badge--neutral">${escapeHTML(cmd.badge)}</span>` : metaHTML(cmd.meta)}</span>`;

        item.addEventListener('mousemove', () => {
          if (cmd.disabled) return;
          setActive(i, false);
        });
        item.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (cmd.disabled) return;
          invoke(i);
        });

        groupUL.appendChild(item);
      });

      // Ensure activeIndex points to a non-disabled, visible item
      if (activeIndex >= filtered.length) activeIndex = 0;
      while (activeIndex < filtered.length && filtered[activeIndex].disabled) activeIndex++;
      if (activeIndex >= filtered.length) activeIndex = 0;

      syncActive();
      $status.textContent = `${filtered.length} result${filtered.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    }

    function syncActive() {
      const items = $listbox.querySelectorAll('.dgo-cmdk__item');
      items.forEach(it => {
        const i = Number(it.dataset.index);
        it.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === activeIndex ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      const id = `cmdk-i-${activeIndex}`;
      $input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', id);
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    }

    function setActive(i, scroll) {
      if (visible[i] && visible[i].disabled) return;
      activeIndex = i;
      syncActive();
    }

    function step(dir) {
      if (!visible.length) return;
      let i = activeIndex;
      for (let n = 0; n < visible.length; n++) {
        i = (i + dir + visible.length) % visible.length;
        if (!visible[i].disabled) { activeIndex = i; syncActive(); return; }
      }
    }

    function invoke(i) {
      const cmd = visible[i];
      if (!cmd || cmd.disabled) return;
      $status.textContent = `Invoked: ${cmd.label}`;
      close('selection');
    }

    function open(source) {
      lastTrigger = document.activeElement;
      $backdrop.dataset.state = 'open';
      if ($main) $main.setAttribute('inert', '');
      $input.value = '';
      activeIndex = 0;
      render('');
      // Defer focus so the dialog has mounted
      requestAnimationFrame(() => $input.focus());
    }

    function close(reason) {
      $backdrop.dataset.state = 'closing';
      if ($main) $main.removeAttribute('inert');
      // Match the exit duration in CSS (--dgo-motion-exit ≈ var(--dgo-dur-fast))
      setTimeout(() => {
        $backdrop.dataset.state = 'closed';
        if (lastTrigger && typeof lastTrigger.focus === 'function') {
          try { lastTrigger.focus(); } catch (e) {}
        }
      }, 180);
    }

    function isOpen() { return $backdrop.dataset.state === 'open'; }

    /* Global opener — Ctrl/⌘ + K, capture phase so an input doesn't swallow it */
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      const isMod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
      if (isMod && (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (isOpen()) {
          $input.select();
        } else {
          open('keyboard');
        }
      }
    }, true);

    /* In-palette keyboard */
    $input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); step(+1); }
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp')   { e.preventDefault(); step(-1); }
      else if (e.key === 'Home')      { e.preventDefault(); activeIndex = 0; syncActive(); }
      else if (e.key === 'End')       { e.preventDefault(); activeIndex = visible.length - 1; syncActive(); }
      else if (e.key === 'Enter')     { e.preventDefault(); invoke(activeIndex); }
      else if (e.key === 'Tab')       { e.preventDefault(); close('tab'); }
      else if (e.key === 'Escape')    {
        e.preventDefault();
        if ($input.value) { $input.value = ''; render(''); }
        else { close('escape'); }
      }
    });

    /* Filter on input */
    $input.addEventListener('input', function () {
      activeIndex = 0;
      render($input.value);
    });

    /* Click outside to close */
    $backdrop.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
      if (e.target === $backdrop) close('outside-click');
    });

    /* Wire the demo button */
    const $openBtn = document.getElementById('cmdkOpen');
    if ($openBtn) $openBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { open('button'); });
  })();
</script>



<div class="theme-toggle" role="group" aria-label="Theme">
  <button data-theme-set="light" aria-pressed="true">Light</button>
  <button data-theme-set="dark" aria-pressed="false">Dark</button>
  <button data-theme-set="hc" aria-pressed="false">HC</button>
  <span style="width:1px; background: var(--dgo-color-border-default); margin: 4px;"></span>
  <button data-density-set="comfortable" aria-pressed="true">Comfortable</button>
  <button data-density-set="compact" aria-pressed="false">Compact</button>
</div>

<script>
  const html = document.documentElement;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-set]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', btn.dataset.themeSet);
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-set]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b === btn));
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-density-set]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      html.setAttribute('data-density', btn.dataset.densitySet);
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-density-set]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b === btn));
    });
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>

/* ============================================================

   ============================================================ */

.dgo-display     { font-size: var(--dgo-type-display);     font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-tight); }
h1, .dgo-h1 { font-size: var(--dgo-type-h1); }
h2, .dgo-h2 { font-size: var(--dgo-type-h2); }

h5, .dgo-h5 { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-lg); }
h6, .dgo-h6 { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body); letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-wide); text-transform: uppercase; }

/* Body */
p, .dgo-body { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body); line-height: var(--dgo-lh-150); text-wrap: pretty; }
.dgo-body-lg { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-lg); line-height: var(--dgo-lh-150); }
.dgo-body-sm { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); line-height: var(--dgo-lh-140); }

}

a, .dgo-link {

}

/* Selection */

.dgo-skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }

/* Print-friendly defaults */
@media print {
  body { background: #fff; color: #000; }
  a { color: #000; text-decoration: underline; }
  a[href^="http"]::after { content: " (" attr(href) ")"; font-size: 0.85em; }
  .dgo-no-print { display: none !important; }
}

/* Container */
.dgo-container {

}
.dgo-container--narrow  { max-width: var(--dgo-c-narrow); }
.dgo-container--text    { max-width: var(--dgo-c-text); }
.dgo-container--content { max-width: var(--dgo-c-content); }
.dgo-container--full    { max-width: var(--dgo-c-full); }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .dgo-container { padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-4); }
}

/* Form field wrapper */
.dgo-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-s-1_5); }

.dgo-switch {

.dgo-pill--escalated { background: var(--dgo-color-status-escalated-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-status-escalated-fg); }
.dgo-pill--info      { background: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-bg);      color: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-fg); }
.dgo-pill--success   { background: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-bg);   color: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-fg); }
.dgo-pill--warning   { background: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-bg);   color: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg); }
.dgo-pill--danger    { background: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-bg);    color: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg); }

/* Counter badge (numeric) */
.dgo-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-inline-size: 18px; block-size: 18px; padding-inline: 5px;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); line-height: 1;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);

}

/* Tag (square) */
.dgo-tag {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
  block-size: var(--dgo-tag-h);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-2);

  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-tag-radius);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken);

/* Chip (interactive tag with × close) */
.dgo-chip {
