  block-size: 28px;
  padding-inline-start: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding-inline-end: var(--dgo-s-1);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary-soft);
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  transition: background var(--dgo-motion-state);
}
.dgo-chip__close {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  inline-size: 20px; block-size: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dgo-chip__close:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-action-primary) 20%, transparent); }

/* ============================================================
   8 · AVATAR
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-avatar {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  inline-size: 36px; block-size: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary-soft);
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-tight);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.dgo-avatar--sm { inline-size: 24px; block-size: 24px; font-size: 11px; }
.dgo-avatar--lg { inline-size: 48px; block-size: 48px; font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-lg); }
.dgo-avatar--xl { inline-size: 72px; block-size: 72px; font-size: var(--dgo-type-h3); }
.dgo-avatar img { inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.dgo-avatar-stack { display: inline-flex; }
.dgo-avatar-stack .dgo-avatar { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--dgo-color-surface-page); }
.dgo-avatar-stack .dgo-avatar + .dgo-avatar { margin-inline-start: -10px; }

/* ============================================================
   9 · CARD
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-card {
  background: var(--dgo-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-card-border);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-card-radius);
  padding: var(--dgo-card-pad);
  transition: box-shadow var(--dgo-motion-state), border-color var(--dgo-motion-state), transform var(--dgo-motion-state);
}
.dgo-card--flat   { box-shadow: var(--dgo-elevation-flat); }
.dgo-card--raised { box-shadow: var(--dgo-elevation-card); }
.dgo-card--hoverable { cursor: pointer; }
.dgo-card--hoverable:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-card-shadow-hover);
  border-color: var(--dgo-color-border-strong);
}
.dgo-card--accent {
  border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--dgo-color-action-accent);
}
.dgo-card__header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-3);
}
.dgo-card__title {
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-display);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-h4);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700);
  line-height: var(--dgo-lh-120);
  margin: 0;
}
.dgo-card__sub { font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); margin: 2px 0 0; }
.dgo-card__footer {
  margin-block-start: var(--dgo-s-4);
  padding-block-start: var(--dgo-s-3);
  border-block-start: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-2);
}

/* Frame — large container shell */
.dgo-frame {
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-frame);
  overflow: clip;
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-elevation-card);
}

/* ============================================================
   10 · ALERT / BANNER
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-alert {
  display: flex; gap: var(--dgo-s-3); align-items: flex-start;
  padding: var(--dgo-alert-pad);
  border: var(--dgo-alert-border-w) solid;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-alert-radius);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
}
.dgo-alert__icon { flex-shrink: 0; margin-block-start: 2px; }
.dgo-alert__title { font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600); margin-block-end: 2px; }
.dgo-alert__body  { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default); }
.dgo-alert--info    { background: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-bg);    color: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-fg);    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-fg) 30%, transparent); }
.dgo-alert--success { background: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-fg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-fg) 30%, transparent); }
.dgo-alert--warning { background: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg) 30%, transparent); }
.dgo-alert--danger  { background: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-bg);  color: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg);  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg) 30%, transparent); }

/* Banner — full-width page-level */
.dgo-banner {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--dgo-s-4);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-3) var(--dgo-s-5);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-brand);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
}

/* ============================================================
   11 · TOAST / SNACKBAR
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-toast-region {
  position: fixed;
  inset-block-end: var(--dgo-s-6);
  inset-inline-end: var(--dgo-s-6);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  z-index: var(--dgo-z-toast);
  max-inline-size: 380px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dgo-toast {
  display: flex; gap: var(--dgo-s-3); align-items: flex-start;
  padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-elevation-overlay);
  pointer-events: auto;
  animation: dgo-toast-in var(--dgo-motion-enter);
}
@keyframes dgo-toast-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

/* ============================================================
   12 · MODAL / DRAWER
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-modal-backdrop {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-overlay);
  z-index: var(--dgo-z-modal);
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
  animation: dgo-fade-in var(--dgo-motion-enter);
}
.dgo-modal {
  inline-size: 100%;
  max-inline-size: var(--dgo-modal-w);
  max-block-size: 90vh;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-modal-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-modal-shadow);
  overflow: clip;
  animation: dgo-modal-in var(--dgo-motion-enter);
}
.dgo-modal--lg { max-inline-size: var(--dgo-modal-w-lg); }
.dgo-modal__header {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--dgo-s-4);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-5) var(--dgo-s-6);
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
}
.dgo-modal__title { font-size: var(--dgo-type-h3); font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); margin: 0; }
.dgo-modal__body { padding: var(--dgo-s-6); overflow-y: auto; }
.dgo-modal__footer {
  padding: var(--dgo-s-4) var(--dgo-s-6);
  border-block-start: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: var(--dgo-s-2);
}
@keyframes dgo-fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes dgo-modal-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.98); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

.dgo-drawer {
  position: fixed; inset-block: 0; inset-inline-end: 0;
  inline-size: var(--dgo-drawer-w); max-inline-size: 100vw;
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-elevation-modal);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  animation: dgo-drawer-in var(--dgo-motion-enter);
  z-index: var(--dgo-z-modal);
}
@keyframes dgo-drawer-in { from { transform: translateX(100%); } to { transform: none; } }
[dir="rtl"] .dgo-drawer { inset-inline-end: auto; inset-inline-start: 0; }

/* ============================================================
   13 · SIDEBAR
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-sidebar {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-s-5);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-5) var(--dgo-s-3);
  background: var(--dgo-sidebar-bg);
  color: var(--dgo-sidebar-fg);
  block-size: 100vh;
  position: sticky;
  inset-block-start: 0;
}
.dgo-sidebar__brand { padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-2); padding-block-end: var(--dgo-s-4); border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-on-brand); }
.dgo-sidebar__nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; flex: 1; }
.dgo-sidebar__group-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700);
  letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-widest);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding-block: var(--dgo-s-3) var(--dgo-s-1);
}

.dgo-sidebar__item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-2) var(--dgo-s-3);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-control);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  transition: background var(--dgo-motion-state), color var(--dgo-motion-state);
  position: relative;
  min-block-size: 36px;
}
.dgo-sidebar__item:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }
.dgo-sidebar__item[aria-current="page"],
.dgo-sidebar__item--active {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  color: #fff;
}
.dgo-sidebar__item[aria-current="page"]::before,
.dgo-sidebar__item--active::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  inset-block: 8px;
  inline-size: 3px;
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent);
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.dgo-sidebar__count {
  margin-inline-start: auto;
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
}
.dgo-sidebar__footer {
  padding-block-start: var(--dgo-s-4);
  border-block-start: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-on-brand);
}

/* ============================================================
   14 · TOPBAR
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-topbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-4);
  block-size: var(--dgo-topbar-h);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-5);
  background: var(--dgo-topbar-bg);
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-topbar-border);
  position: sticky; inset-block-start: 0;
  z-index: var(--dgo-z-sticky);
}

/* ============================================================
   15 · TABS
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-tabs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-s-5); }
.dgo-tabs__list {
  display: flex; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
}
.dgo-tabs__tab {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-2);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-3) var(--dgo-s-4);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  border: 0; background: transparent;
  border-block-end: var(--dgo-tabs-indicator-h) solid transparent;
  margin-block-end: -1px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color var(--dgo-motion-state), border-color var(--dgo-motion-state);
}
.dgo-tabs__tab:hover { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default); }
.dgo-tabs__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  border-block-end-color: var(--dgo-tabs-indicator);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
}

/* ============================================================
   16 · BREADCRUMB
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-crumbs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-2); font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); }
.dgo-crumbs__sep { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-subtle); }
.dgo-crumbs a { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); text-decoration: none; }
.dgo-crumbs a:hover { color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); }
.dgo-crumbs__current { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default); font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600); }

/* ============================================================
   17 · STEPPER / PAGINATION
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-3); }
.dgo-stepper__step {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-2);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
}
.dgo-stepper__bullet {
  inline-size: 28px; block-size: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
}
.dgo-stepper__step[data-state="current"] .dgo-stepper__bullet {
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
  border-color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
}
.dgo-stepper__step[data-state="done"] .dgo-stepper__bullet {
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-accent);
  border-color: var(--dgo-color-action-accent);
}
.dgo-stepper__step[data-state="current"], .dgo-stepper__step[data-state="done"] { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default); }
.dgo-stepper__line { flex: 1; block-size: 2px; background: var(--dgo-color-border-default); border-radius: 2px; }
.dgo-stepper__step[data-state="done"] + .dgo-stepper__line { background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent); }

.dgo-pagination { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1); }
.dgo-pagination__btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-inline-size: var(--dgo-pagination-h); block-size: var(--dgo-pagination-h);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-2);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-pagination-radius);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.dgo-pagination__btn:hover { background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken); }
.dgo-pagination__btn[aria-current="page"] {
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
}
.dgo-pagination__btn:disabled { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-disabled); cursor: not-allowed; }

/* ============================================================
   18 · TABLE / DATA GRID
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-table-wrap {
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-table-border);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
  overflow: clip;
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
}
.dgo-table {
  inline-size: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
}
.dgo-table thead { background: var(--dgo-table-header-bg); }
.dgo-table th {
  text-align: start;
  padding: 0 var(--dgo-table-cell-px);
  block-size: var(--dgo-table-row-h);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-wide);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--dgo-table-header-fg);
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-table-border);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dgo-table td {
  padding: 0 var(--dgo-table-cell-px);
  block-size: var(--dgo-table-row-h);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-table-border);
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.dgo-table tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--dgo-table-row-hover); }
.dgo-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-block-end: 0; }
.dgo-table--striped tbody tr:nth-child(even) td { background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken); }

.dgo-table__num { text-align: end; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.dgo-table__sort {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
  color: inherit; cursor: pointer;
}

/* ============================================================
   19 · TOOLTIP / POPOVER
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-tooltip {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: var(--dgo-tooltip-bg);
  color: var(--dgo-tooltip-fg);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-tooltip-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-3);
  max-inline-size: 280px;
}
.dgo-popover {
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-popover-radius);
  padding: var(--dgo-popover-pad);
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-popover-shadow);
  min-inline-size: 220px;
}

/* ============================================================
   20 · MENU / DROPDOWN
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-menu {
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-1);
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-popover-shadow);
  min-inline-size: 200px;
}
.dgo-menu__item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-2);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-2) var(--dgo-s-3);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-6);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dgo-menu__item:hover, .dgo-menu__item:focus-visible {
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken);
  outline: none;
}
.dgo-menu__item--danger { color: var(--dgo-color-action-danger); }
.dgo-menu__item--danger:hover { background: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-bg); }
.dgo-menu__sep { block-size: 1px; background: var(--dgo-color-border-default); margin: var(--dgo-s-1) 0; }
.dgo-menu__label {
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-wide);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-2) var(--dgo-s-3) var(--dgo-s-1);
}

/* ============================================================
   21 · EMPTY / ERROR / ONBOARDING STATE
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-empty {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-12) var(--dgo-s-6);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
}
.dgo-empty__title { font-size: var(--dgo-type-h4); font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default); }
.dgo-empty__body { max-inline-size: 42ch; }

/* ============================================================
   22 · PROGRESS / SPINNER
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-progress {
  inline-size: 100%;
  block-size: var(--dgo-progress-h);
  background: var(--dgo-progress-track);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.dgo-progress__fill {
  block-size: 100%;
  background: var(--dgo-progress-fill);
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: inline-size var(--dgo-motion-state);
}
.dgo-progress--accent .dgo-progress__fill { background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent); }

.dgo-progress-ring {
  inline-size: 56px; block-size: 56px;
  display: inline-grid; place-items: center;
  --_p: 0; /* @kind other */
  background:
    conic-gradient(var(--dgo-color-action-primary) calc(var(--_p) * 1%), var(--dgo-progress-track) 0);
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
  position: relative;
}
.dgo-progress-ring::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 5px;
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-page);
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.dgo-progress-ring > span { position: relative; }

.dgo-spinner {
  inline-size: 24px; block-size: 24px;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken);
  border-block-start-color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: dgo-spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

/* ============================================================
   23 · SKELETON
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-skeleton {
  display: block;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,
      var(--dgo-skeleton-base) 0%,
      var(--dgo-skeleton-shine) 50%,
      var(--dgo-skeleton-base) 100%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-6);
  animation: dgo-skeleton 1.4s linear infinite;
  min-block-size: 12px;
}
@keyframes dgo-skeleton {
  from { background-position: 200% 0; }
  to { background-position: -200% 0; }
}
.dgo-skeleton--circle { border-radius: 50%; }

/* ============================================================
   24 · METRIC / STAT TILE
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-metric {
  background: var(--dgo-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-card-border);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-card-radius);
  padding: var(--dgo-card-pad);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-s-2);
}
.dgo-metric__label {
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-wide);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
}
.dgo-metric__value {
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-display);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-h1);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700);
  letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-tightest);
  line-height: var(--dgo-lh-110);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-strong);
}
.dgo-metric__delta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
}
.dgo-metric__delta--up { color: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-fg); }
.dgo-metric__delta--down { color: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg); }

/* ============================================================
   25 · KBD / CODE
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-kbd {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
  min-inline-size: 22px; block-size: 22px;
  padding-inline: 6px;
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  background: var(--dgo-kbd-bg);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-kbd-border);
  border-block-end-width: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-4);
}

.dgo-code-block {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  line-height: var(--dgo-lh-150);
  background: var(--dgo-code-bg);
  color: var(--dgo-code-fg);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  overflow-x: auto;
  white-space: pre;
}

.dgo-inline-code {
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono);
  font-size: 0.88em;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-4);
  background: var(--dgo-code-bg);
  color: var(--dgo-code-fg);
}

/* ============================================================
   26 · FILTER BAR / BULK-ACTION BAR
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-filter-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-3); flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: var(--dgo-s-3) var(--dgo-s-4);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
}
.dgo-bulk-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-3) var(--dgo-s-4);
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-radius-card);
}
.dgo-bulk-bar .dgo-btn--ghost { color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand); }
.dgo-bulk-bar .dgo-btn--ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

/* ============================================================
   Utilities
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-divider { block-size: 1px; background: var(--dgo-color-border-default); border: 0; margin-block: var(--dgo-s-5); }

/* Tabular numerals helper */
.dgo-tnum { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  border: var(--dgo-alert-border-w) solid;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-alert-radius);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-raised);

.dgo-alert--success { background: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-fg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-fg) 30%, transparent); }
.dgo-alert--warning { background: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg) 30%, transparent); }
.dgo-alert--danger  { background: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-bg);  color: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg);  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg) 30%, transparent); }

  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-brand);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
}

/* ============================================================
   DGO · Pill / Badge / Tag / Chip
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Inline status, count, label, and filter pellets.

   Layer:        dgo-component
   Namespace:    .dgo-* (BEM)
   Depends on:   tokens/tokens.primitive.css
                 tokens/tokens.semantic.css
                 tokens/tokens.component.css

                 styles/base.css
   No hard-coded colors, sizes, or durations — every value is a var().
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   7 · PILL / BADGE / TAG / CHIP
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
  block-size: var(--dgo-badge-h);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-badge-px);
  font-size: var(--dgo-badge-fs);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-badge-fw);
  line-height: 1;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-badge-radius);
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
}
.dgo-pill__dot { inline-size: 6px; block-size: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

.dgo-pill--pending   { background: var(--dgo-color-status-pending-bg);   color: var(--dgo-color-status-pending-fg); }
.dgo-pill--routed    { background: var(--dgo-color-status-routed-bg);    color: var(--dgo-color-status-routed-fg); }
.dgo-pill--replied   { background: var(--dgo-color-status-replied-bg);   color: var(--dgo-color-status-replied-fg); }
.dgo-pill--action    { background: var(--dgo-color-status-action-bg);    color: var(--dgo-color-status-action-fg); }
.dgo-pill--draft     { background: var(--dgo-color-status-draft-bg);     color: var(--dgo-color-status-draft-fg); }
.dgo-pill--archived  { background: var(--dgo-color-status-archived-bg);  color: var(--dgo-color-status-archived-fg); }
.dgo-pill--escalated { background: var(--dgo-color-status-escalated-bg); color: var(--dgo-color-status-escalated-fg); }
.dgo-pill--info      { background: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-bg);      color: var(--dgo-color-info-subtle-fg); }
.dgo-pill--success   { background: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-bg);   color: var(--dgo-color-success-subtle-fg); }
.dgo-pill--warning   { background: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-bg);   color: var(--dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg); }
.dgo-pill--danger    { background: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-bg);    color: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg); }

/* Counter badge (numeric) */
.dgo-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-inline-size: 18px; block-size: 18px; padding-inline: 5px;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700); line-height: 1;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-danger);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
}

/* Tag (square) */
.dgo-tag {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
  block-size: var(--dgo-tag-h);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-2);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-tag-radius);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-sunken);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
}

/* Chip (interactive tag with × close) */
.dgo-chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1_5);
  block-size: 28px;
  padding-inline-start: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding-inline-end: var(--dgo-s-1);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-r-pill);
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary-soft);
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  transition: background var(--dgo-motion-state);
}
.dgo-chip__close {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  inline-size: 20px; block-size: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dgo-chip__close:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-action-primary) 20%, transparent); }

## File: ./styles/components/button.css
```
/* ============================================================
   DGO · Button
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Action triggers (primary/secondary/tertiary/ghost/danger × sm/md/lg + button-group).

   Layer:        dgo-component
   Namespace:    .dgo-* (BEM)
   Depends on:   tokens/tokens.primitive.css
                 tokens/tokens.semantic.css
                 tokens/tokens.component.css
                 tokens/tokens.density.css
                 styles/base.css
   No hard-coded colors, sizes, or durations — every value is a var().
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   1 · BUTTON
   ============================================================
   States: default · hover · focus-visible · active · disabled · loading
   Variants: primary · secondary · tertiary · ghost · danger
   Sizes: sm · md · lg
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-btn {
  --_h: var(--dgo-btn-h-md);
  --_px: var(--dgo-btn-px-md);
  --_fs: var(--dgo-type-body);

  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-2);
  block-size: var(--_h);
  padding-inline: var(--_px);
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-sans);
  font-size: var(--_fs);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-btn-fw);
  line-height: 1;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-btn-radius);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    background-color var(--dgo-motion-state),
    border-color var(--dgo-motion-state),
    color var(--dgo-motion-state),
    box-shadow var(--dgo-motion-state),
    transform var(--dgo-dur-instant) var(--dgo-ease-sharp);
  min-inline-size: var(--_h); /* hit area floor */
}

.dgo-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow: var(--dgo-focus-ring); }
.dgo-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
.dgo-btn:disabled,
.dgo-btn[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dgo-btn--sm { --_h: var(--dgo-btn-h-sm); --_px: var(--dgo-btn-px-sm); --_fs: var(--dgo-type-body-sm); }
.dgo-btn--lg { --_h: var(--dgo-btn-h-lg); --_px: var(--dgo-btn-px-lg); --_fs: var(--dgo-type-body-lg); }
.dgo-btn--block { inline-size: 100%; }

/* Primary */
.dgo-btn--primary {
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
}
.dgo-btn--primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary-hover); box-shadow: var(--dgo-shadow-2); }
.dgo-btn--primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary-press); }

/* Secondary — outline */
.dgo-btn--secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  border-color: var(--dgo-color-border-strong);
}
.dgo-btn--secondary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-secondary-hover);
}
.dgo-btn--secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--dgo-color-action-secondary-press); }

/* Tertiary — text + subtle hover */
.dgo-btn--tertiary,
.dgo-btn--ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
}
.dgo-btn--tertiary:hover:not(:disabled),
.dgo-btn--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--dgo-color-action-secondary-hover); }

/* Danger */
.dgo-btn--danger {
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-danger);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
}
.dgo-btn--danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--dgo-color-action-danger-hover); }

/* Accent */
.dgo-btn--accent {
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-accent);
}
.dgo-btn--accent:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--dgo-color-action-accent-hover); }

/* Icon button */
.dgo-btn--icon { padding-inline: 0; inline-size: var(--_h); }

/* Loading */
.dgo-btn[data-loading="true"] { color: transparent; position: relative; }
.dgo-btn[data-loading="true"]::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  border-block-start-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-brand);
  animation: dgo-spin 0.6s linear infinite;
}
.dgo-btn--secondary[data-loading="true"]::after,
.dgo-btn--tertiary[data-loading="true"]::after,
.dgo-btn--ghost[data-loading="true"]::after { color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); }

@keyframes dgo-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* Button group */
.dgo-btn-group { display: inline-flex; }
.dgo-btn-group .dgo-btn {
  border-radius: 0;
}
.dgo-btn-group .dgo-btn:first-child { border-start-start-radius: var(--dgo-btn-radius); border-end-start-radius: var(--dgo-btn-radius); }
.dgo-btn-group .dgo-btn:last-child  { border-start-end-radius:   var(--dgo-btn-radius); border-end-end-radius:   var(--dgo-btn-radius); }
.dgo-btn-group .dgo-btn + .dgo-btn { margin-inline-start: -1px; }


```

/* ============================================================

   ------------------------------------------------------------
   White surface container; header / body / footer.

   Layer:        dgo-component
   Namespace:    .dgo-* (BEM)

/* ============================================================
   DGO · Command Palette  (v2.1)
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Keyboard-first launcher. WAI-ARIA APG 1.2 combobox-with-

                 tokens/tokens.density.css

                                                   focus-ring var)
   No hard-coded colors, sizes, or durations — every value is a var().
   ============================================================ */

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Backdrop + state machine
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
.dgo-cmdk-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: var(--dgo-cmdk-z, var(--dgo-z-modal));
  display: grid;
  place-items: start center;
  padding-block-start: 14vh;
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-4);
  background: var(--dgo-cmdk-backdrop-bg, var(--dgo-color-surface-overlay));
  animation: dgo-fade-in var(--dgo-motion-enter);
}
.dgo-cmdk-backdrop[data-state="closed"] { display: none; }
.dgo-cmdk-backdrop[data-state="closing"] { animation: dgo-fade-out var(--dgo-motion-exit) forwards; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Dialog
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
.dgo-cmdk {
  inline-size: 100%;
  max-inline-size: var(--dgo-cmdk-w, clamp(320px, 90vw, 640px));
  max-block-size: min(80vh, 720px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--dgo-cmdk-bg, var(--dgo-color-surface-raised));
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-cmdk-border, var(--dgo-color-border-default));
  border-radius: var(--dgo-cmdk-radius, var(--dgo-r-10));
  box-shadow: var(--dgo-cmdk-shadow, var(--dgo-elevation-modal, var(--dgo-shadow-5)));
  overflow: clip;
  animation: dgo-cmdk-in var(--dgo-motion-enter);
}
.dgo-cmdk-backdrop[data-state="closing"] .dgo-cmdk {
  animation: dgo-cmdk-out var(--dgo-motion-exit) forwards;
}

/* Inline variant — no backdrop, no focus trap, no animation */
.dgo-cmdk--inline {
  position: relative;
  animation: none;
  max-block-size: none;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Search row
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
.dgo-cmdk__search {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-s-4);
  block-size: var(--dgo-cmdk-input-h, 48px);
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  background: var(--dgo-cmdk-input-bg, transparent);
}
.dgo-cmdk__search-icon {
  flex: none;
  inline-size: 20px; block-size: 20px;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75;
}
.dgo-cmdk__input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-inline-size: 0;
  block-size: 100%;
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;            /* the focus surface is the active descendant — see §10 */
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-strong);
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-sans, inherit);
  font-size: var(--dgo-cmdk-input-fs, var(--dgo-type-body-lg));
  line-height: var(--dgo-lh-130, 1.3);
  caret-color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
}
.dgo-cmdk__input::placeholder {
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-subtle);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-400);
}
.dgo-cmdk__input::-webkit-search-cancel-button { display: none; }
.dgo-cmdk__hint {
  flex: none;
  font-size: var(--dgo-size-12, 12px);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-subtle);
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-mono, ui-monospace, monospace);
  letter-spacing: var(--dgo-tr-normal);
  user-select: none;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Listbox
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
.dgo-cmdk__listbox {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--dgo-cmdk-pad, var(--dgo-s-2));
  overflow-y: auto;
  max-block-size: 40vh;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--dgo-color-border-strong) transparent;
}
.dgo-cmdk--inline .dgo-cmdk__listbox { max-block-size: none; }
.dgo-cmdk__listbox::-webkit-scrollbar { inline-size: 8px; }
.dgo-cmdk__listbox::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--dgo-color-border-strong);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

/* Group */
.dgo-cmdk__group { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.dgo-cmdk__group + .dgo-cmdk__group { margin-block-start: var(--dgo-s-2); }
.dgo-cmdk__group > ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.dgo-cmdk__group-label {
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-sans, inherit);
  font-size: var(--dgo-cmdk-group-label-fs, var(--dgo-size-12));
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--dgo-cmdk-group-label-fg, var(--dgo-color-fg-muted));
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-pad, var(--dgo-s-3));
  padding-block: var(--dgo-s-2);
  margin: 0;
}

/* Item */
.dgo-cmdk__item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  min-block-size: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-h, 44px);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-pad, var(--dgo-s-3));
  padding-block: var(--dgo-s-2);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-radius, var(--dgo-r-4));
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-strong);
  font-size: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-fs, var(--dgo-type-body, var(--dgo-size-14)));
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  background: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-bg, transparent);
  transition: background var(--dgo-motion-state, var(--dgo-dur-fast) var(--dgo-ease-standard));
}
.dgo-cmdk__item:hover { background: var(--dgo-color-surface-muted, var(--dgo-color-fg-on-accent)); }
.dgo-cmdk__item[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-bg-active, var(--dgo-color-action-primary-soft, var(--dgo-green-100)));
  color: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-fg-active, var(--dgo-color-fg-strong));
}
.dgo-cmdk__item[aria-selected="true"] .dgo-cmdk__item-icon { color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary); }
.dgo-cmdk__item[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dgo-cmdk__item:active { transform: scale(0.99); transition-duration: var(--dgo-dur-instant, 50ms); }

.dgo-cmdk__item-icon {
  flex: none;
  inline-size: 18px; block-size: 18px;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75;
}
.dgo-cmdk__item-label {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-inline-size: 0;
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-500);
  text-wrap: pretty;
  line-height: var(--dgo-lh-150, 1.5);
}
.dgo-cmdk__item-label mark {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-700);
  padding: 0;
}
.dgo-cmdk__item-meta {
  flex: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-1, 4px);
  color: var(--dgo-cmdk-meta-fg, var(--dgo-color-fg-muted));
  font-size: var(--dgo-size-12, 12px);
}

/* Empty + footer */
.dgo-cmdk__empty {
  padding: var(--dgo-s-6) var(--dgo-s-4);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body, var(--dgo-size-14));
}
.dgo-cmdk__empty strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-strong);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  margin-block-end: var(--dgo-s-1, 4px);
}
.dgo-cmdk__footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-3);
  padding: var(--dgo-s-2) var(--dgo-s-4);
  border-block-start: 1px solid var(--dgo-color-border-default);
  background: var(--dgo-color-surface-muted, transparent);
  font-size: var(--dgo-size-12, 12px);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted);
}
.dgo-cmdk__footer-hint { display: inline-flex; gap: var(--dgo-s-2); align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.dgo-cmdk__footer-brand {
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-sans, inherit);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-subtle);
  font-size: 10px;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Loading + error
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
.dgo-cmdk[data-loading="true"] .dgo-cmdk__listbox { pointer-events: none; }
.dgo-cmdk__loading-row {
  display: block;
  block-size: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-h, 44px);
  margin: var(--dgo-s-1, 4px) 0;
  border-radius: var(--dgo-cmdk-item-radius, var(--dgo-r-4));
}
.dgo-cmdk[data-error="true"] .dgo-cmdk__listbox { display: none; }
.dgo-cmdk__error {
  padding: var(--dgo-s-4);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Keyframes
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
@keyframes dgo-cmdk-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(0.98); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}
@keyframes dgo-cmdk-out {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  to   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(0.98); }
}
@keyframes dgo-fade-out {
  from { opacity: 1; }
  to   { opacity: 0; }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Density
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
[data-density="compact"] .dgo-cmdk {
  --dgo-cmdk-input-h: 40px;
  --dgo-cmdk-item-h: 36px;
  --dgo-cmdk-item-pad: var(--dgo-s-2);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Theme overrides — high-contrast
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
[data-theme="hc"] .dgo-cmdk {
  border-width: 2px;
  border-color: var(--dgo-color-fg-strong);
}
[data-theme="hc"] .dgo-cmdk__input {
  border-block-end: 2px solid var(--dgo-color-fg-strong);
}
[data-theme="hc"] .dgo-cmdk__item[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--dgo-color-action-primary);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-on-accent, #fff);
  outline: 2px solid var(--dgo-color-fg-strong);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Forced-colours fallback (Windows HC, OS-level)
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .dgo-cmdk {
    border: 2px solid CanvasText;
    box-shadow: none;
    background: Canvas;
  }
  .dgo-cmdk__search { border-block-end: 2px solid CanvasText; }
  .dgo-cmdk__input { color: CanvasText; }
  .dgo-cmdk__item[aria-selected="true"] {
    background: Highlight;
    color: HighlightText;
    forced-color-adjust: none;
  }
  .dgo-cmdk__item[aria-selected="true"] .dgo-cmdk__item-icon { color: HighlightText; }
  .dgo-cmdk__item-meta { color: GrayText; }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Reduced-motion fallback
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dgo-cmdk,
  .dgo-cmdk-backdrop,
  .dgo-cmdk-backdrop[data-state="closing"] .dgo-cmdk,
  .dgo-cmdk-backdrop[data-state="closing"] {
    animation: none;
  }
  .dgo-cmdk__item { transition: none; }
  .dgo-cmdk__item:active { transform: none; }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   RTL — the dialog is symmetric; nothing to flip except the
   item chevron used by submenu-bearing rows.
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
[dir="rtl"] .dgo-cmdk__item-chevron[data-rtl-flip] { transform: scaleX(-1); }

/* ============================================================
   DGO · Input & Textarea
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Single-line and multi-line text controls with label, help, and error affordances.

   Layer:        dgo-component
   Namespace:    .dgo-* (BEM)
   Depends on:   tokens/tokens.primitive.css
                 tokens/tokens.semantic.css
                 tokens/tokens.component.css

   No hard-coded colors, sizes, or durations — every value is a var().
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   2 · INPUT / TEXTAREA
   ============================================================ */
.dgo-input,
.dgo-textarea,
.dgo-select__field {
  display: block;
  inline-size: 100%;
  block-size: var(--dgo-input-h);
  padding-inline: var(--dgo-input-px);
  padding-block: 0;
  font-family: var(--dgo-family-sans);
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
  background: var(--dgo-input-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-input-border);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-input-radius);
  transition: border-color var(--dgo-motion-state), box-shadow var(--dgo-motion-state), background-color var(--dgo-motion-state);
}
.dgo-input::placeholder,
.dgo-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--dgo-input-placeholder); }

.dgo-input:hover:not(:disabled),
.dgo-textarea:hover:not(:disabled),
.dgo-select__field:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--dgo-input-border-hover); }

.dgo-input:focus-visible,
.dgo-textarea:focus-visible,
.dgo-select__field:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--dgo-input-border-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--dgo-color-action-primary) 22%, transparent);
}

.dgo-input:disabled,
.dgo-textarea:disabled,
.dgo-select__field:disabled {
  background: var(--dgo-input-bg-disabled);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-disabled);
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.dgo-input[aria-invalid="true"],
.dgo-textarea[aria-invalid="true"],
.dgo-select__field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--dgo-input-border-error); }

.dgo-textarea {
  block-size: auto;
  min-block-size: calc(var(--dgo-input-h) * 2.5);
  padding-block: var(--dgo-s-2);
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: var(--dgo-lh-150);
}

/* Form field wrapper */
.dgo-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-s-1_5); }
.dgo-field__label {
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-body-sm);
  font-weight: var(--dgo-wt-600);
  color: var(--dgo-color-fg-default);
}
.dgo-field__label--req::after { content: " *"; color: var(--dgo-color-action-danger); }
.dgo-field__help { font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption); color: var(--dgo-color-fg-muted); }
.dgo-field__error {
  font-size: var(--dgo-type-caption);
  color: var(--dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--dgo-s-1);
}

/* Input with leading/trailing affordance */
.dgo-input-group {
  display: flex; align-items: stretch;
  border: 1px solid var(--dgo-input-border);
  border-radius: var(--dgo-input-radius);
  background: var(--dgo-input-bg);

}

/* ============================================================
   DGO · Tabs

   Horizontal segmented navigation with active indicator.

   ============================================================ */

}

  max-inline-size: 380px;
  pointer-events: none;

  pointer-events: auto;
  animation: dgo-toast-in var(--dgo-motion-enter);
}

## File: ./styles/layout.css
```
/* ============================================================
   DGO v2.0 — Layout primitives
   stack · cluster · grid · sidebar · split
   ============================================================ */

/* Stack — vertical flow with consistent spacing */
.dgo-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--dgo-density-gap); }
.dgo-stack--1 { gap: var(--dgo-s-1); }
.dgo-stack--2 { gap: var(--dgo-s-2); }
.dgo-stack--3 { gap: var(--dgo-s-3); }
.dgo-stack--4 { gap: var(--dgo-s-4); }
.dgo-stack--5 { gap: var(--dgo-s-5); }
.dgo-stack--6 { gap: var(--dgo-s-6); }
.dgo-stack--8 { gap: var(--dgo-s-8); }
.dgo-stack--12 { gap: var(--dgo-s-12); }

/* Cluster — wrapping horizontal flow */
.dgo-cluster {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-density-gap);
}
.dgo-cluster--2 { gap: var(--dgo-s-2); }
.dgo-cluster--3 { gap: var(--dgo-s-3); }
.dgo-cluster--4 { gap: var(--dgo-s-4); }
.dgo-cluster--end { justify-content: flex-end; }
.dgo-cluster--between { justify-content: space-between; }

/* Row — horizontal flex, non-wrapping by default */
.dgo-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--dgo-density-gap);
  align-items: center;
}
.dgo-row--top    { align-items: flex-start; }
.dgo-row--bottom { align-items: flex-end; }
.dgo-row--baseline { align-items: baseline; }
.dgo-row--stretch { align-items: stretch; }
.dgo-row--between { justify-content: space-between; }
.dgo-row--end     { justify-content: flex-end; }
.dgo-row--center  { justify-content: center; }

.dgo-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; }

/* Grid */
.dgo-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--dgo-density-gap);
}
.dgo-grid--2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.dgo-grid--3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.dgo-grid--4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.dgo-grid--6 { grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.dgo-grid--12 { grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.dgo-grid--auto { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .dgo-grid--3, .dgo-grid--4, .dgo-grid--6 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .dgo-grid--12 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .dgo-grid--2, .dgo-grid--3, .dgo-grid--4, .dgo-grid--6 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .dgo-grid--12 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}

/* Sidebar layout — fixed-width sidebar + fluid content */
.dgo-sidebar-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--dgo-sidebar-w) minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 100vh;
}
.dgo-sidebar-layout--collapsed {
  grid-template-columns: var(--dgo-sidebar-w-collapsed) minmax(0, 1fr);
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .dgo-sidebar-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* Split — two columns, prefer space-between */
.dgo-split {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--dgo-s-4);
}

/* App shell scaffold */
.dgo-app {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
.dgo-app__topbar { grid-row: 1; }
.dgo-app__body   { grid-row: 2; min-height: 0; }

/* Container queries (component-level reflow) */
.dgo-cq { container-type: inline-size; }

```


## File: ./styles/reset.css
```
/* ============================================================
   DGO v2.0 — Modern Reset
   ============================================================ */

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  -moz-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, figure, blockquote, dl, dd { margin: 0; }
ul[role="list"], ol[role="list"] { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }

a { color: inherit; }
img, picture, video, canvas, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; }

button {
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

table { border-collapse: collapse; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* Focus outline replaced everywhere with semantic focus ring */
:focus { outline: none; }
:focus-visible { outline: none; }

/* Logical-only margin reset for RTL safety */
ul, ol {
  padding-inline-start: 1.5rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   DGO Design System v2.0 — Semantic Tokens
   Intent-named. Components consume these.
   Theme files (light/dark/hc) re-bind these to primitives.
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  /* ---------- Action / brand ---------- */
  --dgo-color-action-primary:        var(--dgo-green-700);
  --dgo-color-action-primary-hover:  var(--dgo-green-800);
  --dgo-color-action-primary-press:  var(--dgo-green-900);
  --dgo-color-action-primary-soft:   var(--dgo-green-50);

  --dgo-color-action-accent:         var(--dgo-smart-400);
  --dgo-color-action-accent-hover:   var(--dgo-smart-500);
  --dgo-color-action-accent-press:   var(--dgo-smart-600);
  --dgo-color-action-accent-soft:    var(--dgo-smart-50);

  --dgo-color-action-secondary:      transparent;
  --dgo-color-action-secondary-hover:var(--dgo-green-50);
  --dgo-color-action-secondary-press:var(--dgo-green-100);

  --dgo-color-action-danger:         var(--dgo-danger-600);
  --dgo-color-action-danger-hover:   var(--dgo-danger-800);
  --dgo-color-action-danger-soft:    var(--dgo-danger-50);

  /* ---------- Surface ---------- */
  --dgo-color-surface-page:      var(--dgo-paper);
  --dgo-color-surface-raised:    var(--dgo-paper-raised);
  --dgo-color-surface-sunken:    var(--dgo-paper-sunken);
  --dgo-color-surface-muted:     var(--dgo-ink-50);
  --dgo-color-surface-inverse:   var(--dgo-green-900);
  --dgo-color-surface-brand:     var(--dgo-green-700);
  --dgo-color-surface-overlay:   var(--dgo-overlay-tint);

  /* ---------- Foreground / text ---------- */
  --dgo-color-fg-default:        var(--dgo-ink-900);
  --dgo-color-fg-strong:         var(--dgo-ink-1000);
  --dgo-color-fg-muted:          var(--dgo-ink-500);
  --dgo-color-fg-subtle:         var(--dgo-ink-400);
  --dgo-color-fg-disabled:       var(--dgo-ink-300);
  --dgo-color-fg-on-brand:       var(--dgo-ink-0);
  --dgo-color-fg-on-accent:      var(--dgo-ink-0);
  --dgo-color-fg-link:           var(--dgo-green-700);
  --dgo-color-fg-link-hover:     var(--dgo-smart-500);
  --dgo-color-fg-link-visited:   var(--dgo-green-800);

  /* ---------- Border ---------- */
  --dgo-color-border-default:    var(--dgo-ink-100);
  --dgo-color-border-strong:     var(--dgo-ink-200);
  --dgo-color-border-stronger:   var(--dgo-ink-300);
  --dgo-color-border-brand:      var(--dgo-green-700);
  --dgo-color-border-accent:     var(--dgo-smart-400);
  --dgo-color-border-on-brand:   rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20);
  --dgo-color-border-focus:      var(--dgo-smart-400);

  /* ---------- Status (subtle + strong pairs) ---------- */
  --dgo-color-info-subtle-bg:    var(--dgo-info-50);
  --dgo-color-info-subtle-fg:    var(--dgo-info-800);
  --dgo-color-info-strong-bg:    var(--dgo-info-600);
  --dgo-color-info-strong-fg:    var(--dgo-ink-0);

  --dgo-color-success-subtle-bg: var(--dgo-smart-50);
  --dgo-color-success-subtle-fg: var(--dgo-smart-600);
  --dgo-color-success-strong-bg: var(--dgo-smart-500);
  --dgo-color-success-strong-fg: var(--dgo-ink-0);

  --dgo-color-warning-subtle-bg: var(--dgo-warn-50);
  --dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg: var(--dgo-warn-800);
  --dgo-color-warning-strong-bg: var(--dgo-warn-400);
  --dgo-color-warning-strong-fg: var(--dgo-ink-900);

  --dgo-color-danger-subtle-bg:  var(--dgo-danger-50);
  --dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg:  var(--dgo-danger-800);
  --dgo-color-danger-strong-bg:  var(--dgo-danger-600);
  --dgo-color-danger-strong-fg:  var(--dgo-ink-0);

  /* ---------- Operational status (DGO workflow) ---------- */
  --dgo-color-status-pending-bg:    var(--dgo-warn-50);
  --dgo-color-status-pending-fg:    var(--dgo-warn-800);
  --dgo-color-status-routed-bg:     var(--dgo-info-50);
  --dgo-color-status-routed-fg:     var(--dgo-info-800);
  --dgo-color-status-replied-bg:    var(--dgo-smart-50);
  --dgo-color-status-replied-fg:    var(--dgo-smart-600);
  --dgo-color-status-action-bg:     var(--dgo-danger-50);
  --dgo-color-status-action-fg:     var(--dgo-danger-800);
  --dgo-color-status-draft-bg:      var(--dgo-green-50);
  --dgo-color-status-draft-fg:      var(--dgo-green-800);
  --dgo-color-status-archived-bg:   var(--dgo-ink-50);
  --dgo-color-status-archived-fg:   var(--dgo-ink-600);
  --dgo-color-status-escalated-bg:  #FAD2D9;
  --dgo-color-status-escalated-fg:  #780820;

  /* ---------- Focus ring ---------- */
  --dgo-focus-ring:    0 0 0 2px var(--dgo-color-surface-page), 0 0 0 5px var(--dgo-smart-400); /* @kind shadow */
  --dgo-focus-ring-inset: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--dgo-smart-400); /* @kind shadow */

  /* ---------- Type intent ---------- */
  --dgo-type-display-xxl: var(--dgo-size-60); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-display-xl:  var(--dgo-size-48); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-display:     var(--dgo-size-40); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-h1:          var(--dgo-size-33); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-h2:          var(--dgo-size-28); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-h3:          var(--dgo-size-23); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-h4:          var(--dgo-size-19); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-body-lg:     var(--dgo-size-16); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-body:        var(--dgo-size-14); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-body-sm:     var(--dgo-size-12); /* @kind font */
  --dgo-type-caption:     var(--dgo-size-12); /* @kind font */

  /* ---------- Radius intent ---------- */
  --dgo-radius-sharp:    var(--dgo-r-2);
  --dgo-radius-control:  var(--dgo-r-6);
  --dgo-radius-card:     var(--dgo-r-10);
  --dgo-radius-frame:    var(--dgo-r-18);
  --dgo-radius-circle:   var(--dgo-r-pill);

  /* ---------- Elevation intent ---------- */
  --dgo-elevation-flat:    var(--dgo-shadow-0); /* @kind shadow */
  --dgo-elevation-card:    var(--dgo-shadow-2); /* @kind shadow */
  --dgo-elevation-raised:  var(--dgo-shadow-3); /* @kind shadow */
  --dgo-elevation-overlay: var(--dgo-shadow-4); /* @kind shadow */
  --dgo-elevation-modal:   var(--dgo-shadow-5); /* @kind shadow */
  --dgo-elevation-popover: var(--dgo-shadow-4); /* @kind shadow */

  /* ---------- Motion intent ---------- */
  --dgo-motion-enter:  var(--dgo-dur-slow) var(--dgo-ease-entrance); /* @kind other */
  --dgo-motion-exit:   var(--dgo-dur-fast) var(--dgo-ease-exit); /* @kind other */
  --dgo-motion-state:  var(--dgo-dur-base) var(--dgo-ease-standard); /* @kind other */
  --dgo-motion-hero:   var(--dgo-dur-deliberate) var(--dgo-ease-emphasized); /* @kind other */
}

/* ============= Reduced motion ============= */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  :root {
    --dgo-dur-instant:    0ms; /* @kind other */
    --dgo-dur-fast:       0ms; /* @kind other */
    --dgo-dur-base:       0ms; /* @kind other */
    --dgo-dur-slow:       50ms; /* @kind other */
    --dgo-dur-deliberate: 50ms; /* @kind other */
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   DGO v2.0 — Theme: Dark
   Activated by [data-theme="dark"].
   Re-binds semantic tokens; primitives untouched.
   ============================================================ */

[data-theme="dark"] {
  /* Surfaces */
  --dgo-paper:                #0B1410;
  --dgo-paper-raised:         #122019;
  --dgo-paper-sunken:         #081109;
  --dgo-overlay-tint:         rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72);

  --dgo-color-surface-page:   #0B1410;
  --dgo-color-surface-raised: #122019;
  --dgo-color-surface-sunken: #081109;
  --dgo-color-surface-muted:  #162720;
  --dgo-color-surface-inverse:#FFFFFF;
  --dgo-color-surface-brand:  var(--dgo-green-700);

  /* Text */
  --dgo-color-fg-default:     #E8EDEA;
  --dgo-color-fg-strong:      #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-color-fg-muted:       #9AA8A2;
  --dgo-color-fg-subtle:      #6F7E78;
  --dgo-color-fg-disabled:    #4F5C57;
  --dgo-color-fg-on-brand:    #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-color-fg-link:        var(--dgo-smart-300);
  --dgo-color-fg-link-hover:  var(--dgo-smart-200);

  /* Borders */
  --dgo-color-border-default: #1F2F27;
  --dgo-color-border-strong:  #2D3F36;
  --dgo-color-border-stronger:#42554B;

  /* Status — keep subtle bg low-saturation, fg high-contrast */
  --dgo-color-info-subtle-bg:    rgba(42,138,209,0.18);
  --dgo-color-info-subtle-fg:    #82BFE8;
  --dgo-color-success-subtle-bg: rgba(23,178,85,0.18);
  --dgo-color-success-subtle-fg: #6FE0A0;
  --dgo-color-warning-subtle-bg: rgba(225,161,0,0.18);
  --dgo-color-warning-subtle-fg: #F6CE5C;
  --dgo-color-danger-subtle-bg:  rgba(200,16,46,0.20);
  --dgo-color-danger-subtle-fg:  #F1909F;

  /* Operational status — dark */
  --dgo-color-status-pending-bg:   rgba(225,161,0,0.18);
  --dgo-color-status-pending-fg:   #F6CE5C;
  --dgo-color-status-routed-bg:    rgba(42,138,209,0.18);
  --dgo-color-status-routed-fg:    #82BFE8;
  --dgo-color-status-replied-bg:   rgba(23,178,85,0.18);
  --dgo-color-status-replied-fg:   #6FE0A0;
  --dgo-color-status-action-bg:    rgba(200,16,46,0.20);
  --dgo-color-status-action-fg:    #F1909F;
  --dgo-color-status-draft-bg:     rgba(5,88,59,0.30);
  --dgo-color-status-draft-fg:     #9CD1B5;
  --dgo-color-status-archived-bg:  #1A2925;
  --dgo-color-status-archived-fg:  #9AA8A2;
  --dgo-color-status-escalated-bg: rgba(120,8,32,0.45);
  --dgo-color-status-escalated-fg: #F4B5BF;

  /* Component re-binds */
  --dgo-card-bg:           #122019;
  --dgo-card-border:       #1F2F27;
  --dgo-input-bg:          #0E1A14;
  --dgo-input-bg-disabled: #162720;
  --dgo-input-border:      #2D3F36;
  --dgo-table-header-bg:   #0E1A14;
  --dgo-table-row-hover:   #162720;

  /* Shadows lighter in dark */
  --dgo-shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.40);
  --dgo-shadow-2: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30);
  --dgo-shadow-3: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50), 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30);
  --dgo-shadow-4: 0 10px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  --dgo-shadow-5: 0 20px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.60);

  --dgo-focus-ring: 0 0 0 2px #0B1410, 0 0 0 5px var(--dgo-smart-300);

  color-scheme: dark;
}

/* ============================================================
   DGO v2.0 — Theme: High-Contrast
   Activated by [data-theme="hc"].
   Targets WCAG 2.2 AAA where possible.
   ============================================================ */

[data-theme="hc"] {
  --dgo-paper:                #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-paper-raised:         #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-paper-sunken:         #F5F4F4;

  --dgo-color-surface-page:   #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-color-surface-raised: #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-color-surface-sunken: #F0EFEF;
  --dgo-color-surface-muted:  #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-color-surface-inverse:#000000;

  /* Text — pushed to black/white */
  --dgo-color-fg-default:     #000000;
  --dgo-color-fg-strong:      #000000;
  --dgo-color-fg-muted:       #2D2C2C;
  --dgo-color-fg-subtle:      #4A4849;
  --dgo-color-fg-on-brand:    #FFFFFF;
  --dgo-color-fg-link:        #022819;
  --dgo-color-fg-link-hover:  #000000;

  /* Borders — high contrast */
  --dgo-color-border-default: #000000;
  --dgo-color-border-strong:  #000000;
  --dgo-color-border-stronger:#000000;

  /* Action — deepest greens */
  --dgo-color-action-primary:        #022819;
  --dgo-color-action-primary-hover:  #000000;
  --dgo-color-action-primary-press:  #000000;
  --dgo-color-action-accent:         #0A5828;
  --dgo-color-action-danger:         #780820;

  /* Status — bold colors, dark text */
  --dgo-color-status-pending-bg:    #FBF1D8;
  --dgo-color-status-pending-fg:    #5A3F00;
  --dgo-color-status-routed-bg:     #E6F0F8;
  --dgo-color-status-routed-fg:     #054871;
  --dgo-color-status-replied-bg:    #C2EED2;
  --dgo-color-status-replied-fg:    #07401D;
  --dgo-color-status-action-bg:     #FBE7EB;
  --dgo-color-status-action-fg:     #780820;
  --dgo-color-status-draft-bg:      #CFE3D8;
  --dgo-color-status-draft-fg:      #022819;
  --dgo-color-status-archived-bg:   #E8E6E7;
  --dgo-color-status-archived-fg:   #000000;
  --dgo-color-status-escalated-bg:  #780820;
  --dgo-color-status-escalated-fg:  #FFFFFF;

  /* Components */
  --dgo-card-border:       #000000;
  --dgo-input-border:      #000000;
  --dgo-input-border-hover:#000000;
  --dgo-table-border:      #000000;

  /* Focus — thicker, black-and-yellow stack */
  --dgo-focus-ring: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 6px #000000, 0 0 0 9px #E1A100;

  color-scheme: light;
}

/* When the OS asks for forced colors, lean on system colors */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  :root {
    --dgo-color-action-primary: ButtonText;
    --dgo-color-border-default: CanvasText;
    --dgo-color-fg-default: CanvasText;
    --dgo-color-fg-link: LinkText;
  }
}

```

## File: ./scaffold.sh
```
#!/bin/bash
# CONFIGURATION: Modify these lists to fit your project type
TARGET_DIR="${1:-.}"
IGNORE_LIST="node_modules|\.git|\.venv|dist|build|__pycache__|\.terraform|\.DS_Store"
CODE_EXTENSIONS="md|txt|py|js|ts|go|rs|sql|json|yaml|yml|sh|css|html|scss|sass"

TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
BASE_NAME="project_context_$TIMESTAMP"
OUT_DIR="$BASE_NAME"

# OVERWRITE MITIGATION: Auto-increment if folder exists
COUNTER=1
while [ -d "$OUT_DIR" ]; do OUT_DIR="${BASE_NAME}_${COUNTER}"; COUNTER=$((COUNTER+1)); done
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
FULL_DOC="$OUT_DIR/complete_project_context.md"

# 1. GENERATE TREE
tree "$TARGET_DIR" -I "$IGNORE_LIST|$OUT_DIR" > "$OUT_DIR/folder_tree.txt"

# 2. GENERATE MANIFEST
find "$TARGET_DIR" -type f | grep -vE "$IGNORE_LIST|$OUT_DIR" > "$OUT_DIR/manifest.txt"

# 3. GENERATE MASTER DOC WITH AI SCHEMA
FILE_COUNT=$(wc -l < "$OUT_DIR/manifest.txt")
cat <<EOF > "$FULL_DOC"
---
# AI CONTEXT SCHEMA
{
  "project_path": "$TARGET_DIR",
  "generated_at": "$(date)",
  "total_files_scanned": $FILE_COUNT,
  "description": "Consolidated project context for LLM retrieval. Binaries cataloged as assets."
}
---
EOF

# 4. CONTENT AGGREGATION
while read -r FILE; do
    EXT="${FILE##*.}"
    echo -e "\n\n## File: $FILE\n\`\`\`" >> "$FULL_DOC"
    if [[ "$CODE_EXTENSIONS" =~ "$EXT" ]]; then
        cat "$FILE" 2>/dev/null >> "$FULL_DOC"
    else
        echo "[Content excluded: Binary/Asset - Metadata: $(file -b "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")]" >> "$FULL_DOC"
    fi
    echo -e "\n\`\`\`" >> "$FULL_DOC"
done < "$OUT_DIR/manifest.txt"

echo ">>> Scaffolding complete. Artifacts in: $OUT_DIR"

```
